title: 量化金融，从零搭建 · 第41部分：杠杆、流动性与危机

chapters.Hook: 一只加杠杆的基金必须卖掉多少？
chapters.House: 11. 第41条规则：挺过还没收到的追加保证金通知
chapters.Outro: 回顾、交易台问题与习题

0b79a9e1cfa7.en: Part forty-one. Leverage, liquidity and crises: how borrowed money and short funding turn small losses into forced sales, forced sales into spirals, and one firm's trouble into everyone's. From LTCM to Silicon Valley Bank, with the mathematics of each.
0b79a9e1cfa7.zh: 第41部分。杠杆、流动性与危机：借来的钱和短期融资如何把小额亏损变成被迫抛售，把被迫抛售变成螺旋，把一家公司的麻烦变成所有人的麻烦。从长期资本管理公司到硅谷银行，每一个都配上它的数学。

308a5065201e.en: What this part illustrates. <bookmark mark='a'/> In the chosen spiral, a three percent shock ends as a 22 percent fall, 7.3 times larger; these are model outputs, not an estimated universal multiplier. <bookmark mark='b'/> In our symmetric ten-bank complete network, shocks within the half-dollar buffer cause no default; above that buffer and up to 5, only the shocked bank fails; beyond it all ten fail. <bookmark mark='c'/> In a chosen run game with early liquidation value eighty-five percent, the limiting threshold is 1.49, under specified payoff and signal assumptions. Solvency alone need not prevent a run. <bookmark mark='d'/> And during March twenty twenty, the Treasury yield rose from 0.54 to 1.18 percent between March ninth and eighteenth, while stocks fell.
308a5065201e.zh: 本部分的例子。<bookmark mark='a'/>在选定螺旋模型中，百分之三冲击最终造成22%跌幅，放大7.3倍；这是模型输出，不是估计出的普遍乘数。<bookmark mark='b'/>选定十家银行的对称完全网络中，冲击不超过半元缓冲时无违约；超过缓冲、但不超过5时，仅受冲击者违约；再大则十家全部违约。<bookmark mark='c'/>选定提前清算价值为百分之八十五的挤兑博弈，在特定收益与信号假设下，极限阈值为1.49。仅有偿付能力未必能阻止挤兑。<bookmark mark='d'/>二〇二〇年三月九日至十八日，股市下跌时国债收益率从0.54%升到1.18%。

a91ae5a8b953.en: Why it matters. <bookmark mark='a'/> LTCM, Bear Stearns, Lehman, AIG, Archegos, Silicon Valley Bank and Credit Suisse illustrate failures, rescues and acquisitions, with different legal and economic outcomes. <bookmark mark='b'/> Crises helped shape capital and liquidity ratios, central clearing, stress tests and resolution planning; no single event explains every rule. <bookmark mark='c'/> And the proposed House books need financing. Part forty measured potential losses; this part asks how funding terms affect survival.
a91ae5a8b953.zh: 为什么重要。<bookmark mark='a'/>LTCM、贝尔斯登、雷曼、AIG、Archegos、硅谷银行与瑞士信贷展示了破产、救助和并购等不同法律与经济结果。<bookmark mark='b'/>危机促使资本与流动性比率、中央清算、压力测试和处置规划演变，但不能用单一事件解释全部规则。<bookmark mark='c'/>本系列公司的拟议账簿也需要融资。第40部分衡量可能的损失，本部分研究融资条款如何影响生存。

e2c589443aa0.en: And what this part is not. <bookmark mark='a'/> It is not prediction: no model here says when the next crisis comes, only how a shock grows and what makes a system fragile. <bookmark mark='b'/> It is not blame: firms appear as the public record describes them. <bookmark mark='c'/> And it is not advice.
e2c589443aa0.zh: 以及这一部分不是什么。<bookmark mark='a'/>它不是预测：这里没有一个模型能说出下一场危机何时到来，它们只说明冲击如何放大、什么让体系变得脆弱。<bookmark mark='b'/>它不是追责：公司只按公开记录的描述出现。<bookmark mark='c'/>它也不是投资建议。

b3699c17f289.en: Where this sits. Act seven, the system. Part forty measured risk one firm at a time. This part follows leverage and liquidity across firms, into crises. Then Part forty-two lets machines into the market, and Part forty-three asks whether any of it beats the market.
b3699c17f289.zh: 这一部分的位置。第七幕，体系。第40部分逐家公司地度量风险。这一部分沿着杠杆和流动性跨越公司，走进危机。接着第42部分让机器进入市场，第43部分追问这一切能否战胜市场。

12800ea220b3.en: Forty years of crises, and of the theory that followed them. Diamond and Dybvig's bank runs; the crash of nineteen eighty-seven; Shleifer and Vishny's limits to selling; LTCM. <bookmark mark='a'/> Eisenberg and Noe's clearing, Lehman and AIG, Brunnermeier and Pedersen's spirals, Geanakoplos's leverage cycle. <bookmark mark='b'/> Then Shanghai and the contagion threshold, SRISK, the dash for cash, and the runs of twenty twenty-three.
12800ea220b3.zh: 四十年的危机，以及随之而来的理论。戴蒙德和迪布维格的银行挤兑；一九八七年的股灾；施莱弗和维什尼关于抛售的极限；长期资本管理公司。<bookmark mark='a'/>艾森伯格和诺伊的清算模型，雷曼和AIG，布伦纳迈尔和佩德森的螺旋，吉纳科普洛斯的杠杆周期。<bookmark mark='b'/>然后是上海股灾和传染阈值、SRISK、现金争夺战，以及二〇二三年的挤兑。

ee879940e202.en: The plan: leverage and its cycle; spirals and fire sales; networks of obligations; systemic risk measured; five crises from public data; bank runs and the House's own liquidity stress; and the theorem behind network clearing, proved.
ee879940e202.zh: 计划：杠杆及其周期；螺旋与甩卖；债务网络；度量系统性风险；用公开数据看五场危机；银行挤兑与本系列公司自己的流动性压力测试；以及网络清算背后的定理，给出证明。

23dea73968dc.en: In the House, the treasury and funding desk joins the risk function, and asks a question no risk number answers on its own: if every lender wanted more at once, what would the House have to sell?
23dea73968dc.zh: 在本系列公司里，资金与融资部门加入风险部门，提出一个任何单一风险数字都回答不了的问题：如果所有贷款方同时要求更多，本系列公司必须卖掉什么？

4bf17e383022.en: A desk question to start. <bookmark mark='a'/> A fund at five times leverage loses ten percent. <bookmark mark='b'/> Its lender raises the haircut on its collateral from twenty to thirty percent. <bookmark mark='c'/> Pause and predict: how much must it sell?
4bf17e383022.zh: 先来一个交易台问题。<bookmark mark='a'/>一只五倍杠杆的基金亏了百分之十。<bookmark mark='b'/>它的贷款方把抵押品的折扣率从百分之二十提高到百分之三十。<bookmark mark='c'/>暂停并预测：它必须卖掉多少？

8ee8bb1966fb.en: Chapter one. In the chosen example the fund sells 56.7 out of 90, or about sixty-three percent of remaining assets. The initial loss takes equity from twenty to 10; the thirty-percent haircut permits only 33.3 of assets. The amount follows from fixed debt, a binding collateral cap and debt-repaying sales. Real contracts, fees and price impact may change the requirement; the exercise illustrates the mechanism rather than explaining every crisis by one balance sheet.
8ee8bb1966fb.zh: 第1章。选定例子卖出剩余90中的56.7，约百分之六十三。亏损使权益从二十降至10；百分之三十折扣率只容许33.3资产。这里假设固定债务、约束生效及卖出款还债。真实合同、费用与价格冲击可能改变要求；本例说明机制，不是用一张表解释全部危机。

ced9383561b3.en: The arithmetic for a fixed balance sheet. <bookmark mark='a'/> Assets equal equity plus debt. <bookmark mark='b'/> Leverage is assets divided by equity. <bookmark mark='c'/> The equity return is leverage times the asset return, minus leverage less one times the debt return. <bookmark mark='d'/> If debt has zero return and there are no hedges or other claims, an asset fall of one over leverage exhausts equity: twenty percent at five times and about three point three percent at thirty times. This is a balance-sheet approximation, not a complete bank valuation.
ced9383561b3.zh: 固定资产负债表的算术。<bookmark mark='a'/>资产等于权益加债务。<bookmark mark='b'/>杠杆为资产除权益。<bookmark mark='c'/>权益收益等于杠杆乘资产收益，再减杠杆减一乘债务收益。<bookmark mark='d'/>若债务收益为零、无对冲或其他债权，资产跌幅达到杠杆倒数就耗尽权益：五倍时百分之二十，三十倍时约百分之三点三。这是表内近似，并非完整银行估值。

bf62bc508f68.en: The collateral constraint. <bookmark mark='a'/> A secured lender advances one minus the haircut times collateral value. <bookmark mark='b'/> In this single-book model, equity must fund the haircut, giving maximum leverage one over h. <bookmark mark='c'/> A higher haircut forces a sale when the holder exceeds the new cap. A holder already below it need not shrink. Multiple collateral pools, offsets and contractual terms can change the constraint.
bf62bc508f68.zh: 抵押约束。<bookmark mark='a'/>担保贷款金额为抵押品价值乘以一减折扣率。<bookmark mark='b'/>在这一单一账簿模型中，折扣部分由权益承担，因此最大杠杆为一除h。<bookmark mark='c'/>提高折扣率只有在新上限约束持仓时才迫使卖出；本已低于上限者不必减仓。多个抵押池、净额抵销和合同条款会改变约束。

c8fdf96c7f69.en: The table uses one hundred of assets and twenty of equity. <bookmark mark='a'/> With no loss, moving the haircut from twenty to thirty percent forces a third of the remaining book to be sold. <bookmark mark='b'/> After a ten percent asset loss, assets are ninety and equity ten. A forty percent haircut permits twenty-five of assets, about twenty-eight percent of the ninety remaining. The sale is about seventy-two percent. These two balance-sheet shocks compound.
c8fdf96c7f69.zh: 表中初始资产一百、权益二十。<bookmark mark='a'/>没有损失时，折扣率从百分之二十升至三十，须卖出剩余账簿三分之一。<bookmark mark='b'/>资产先跌百分之十后，资产九十、权益十。百分之四十折扣率只容许资产二十五，是剩余九十的约百分之二十八，须卖约百分之七十二。两种资产负债表冲击叠加。

6cc5b9f19afd.en: Hyman Minsky's three kinds of borrower. <bookmark mark='a'/> Hedge finance: income covers interest and principal. <bookmark mark='b'/> Speculative finance: income covers the interest, and the principal must be rolled over, so the borrower depends on lenders. <bookmark mark='c'/> Ponzi finance: income covers neither, and the borrower depends on rising prices. His point was that calm years move borrowers down the list: stability breeds instability.
6cc5b9f19afd.zh: 海曼·明斯基的三类借款人。<bookmark mark='a'/>对冲性融资：收入足以覆盖利息和本金。<bookmark mark='b'/>投机性融资：收入覆盖利息，本金必须滚动续借，所以借款人依赖贷款方。<bookmark mark='c'/>庞氏融资：收入两者都覆盖不了，借款人依赖价格上涨。他的观点是，平静的年份会让借款人沿着这张清单往下走：稳定孕育着不稳定。

dbde6a015023.en: Charles Kindleberger's anatomy of a crisis. <bookmark mark='a'/> A displacement, a new technology or policy, opens profits; credit expands into a boom; prices outrun income in euphoria. <bookmark mark='b'/> Insiders sell in distress, and then everyone sells in panic. He found the same five stages from the South Sea Bubble onward; this part's crises follow them too.
dbde6a015023.zh: 查尔斯·金德尔伯格对危机的解剖。<bookmark mark='a'/>一次外部冲击，一项新技术或新政策，打开了获利空间；信贷扩张成繁荣；在狂热中价格跑赢收入。<bookmark mark='b'/>内部人在困境中卖出，然后所有人在恐慌中抛售。他从南海泡沫开始就发现了同样的五个阶段；这一部分的危机也遵循它们。

0e6f30932a76.en: John Geanakoplos's leverage cycle, in a heterogeneous-belief collateral model. <bookmark mark='a'/> Marginal buyers' valuations and financing constraints jointly help set price. <bookmark mark='b'/> Generous collateral terms let optimistic buyers hold more of the supply. <bookmark mark='c'/> Bad news and tighter haircuts can force those constrained buyers to sell to less optimistic investors, amplifying the price move. This mechanism is conditional on the model's trading and collateral structure; it is not a theorem that every optimist is wiped out.
0e6f30932a76.zh: 吉纳科普洛斯的杠杆周期，在异质信念抵押模型中。<bookmark mark='a'/>边际买方估值与融资约束共同影响价格。<bookmark mark='b'/>宽松抵押条件使乐观者能持有更多供给。<bookmark mark='c'/>坏消息与更高折扣率可能迫使受约束的乐观者向较悲观者出售，从而放大价格变化。机制取决于模型的交易和抵押结构，并不是所有乐观者必被清零的定理。

c1b60ecb9f0b.en: Two kinds of liquidity. <bookmark mark='a'/> Market liquidity: how much a sale moves the price, Parts thirty-six and thirty-seven. <bookmark mark='b'/> Funding liquidity: how easily a position can be financed, Parts two and twenty-one. <bookmark mark='c'/> And they feed each other: lower prices raise margins, higher margins force sales, and sales lower prices.
c1b60ecb9f0b.zh: 两种流动性。<bookmark mark='a'/>市场流动性：一笔卖单对价格的影响有多大，第36和第37部分。<bookmark mark='b'/>融资流动性：一个头寸多容易获得融资，第2和第21部分。<bookmark mark='c'/>它们相互喂养：价格下跌提高保证金，保证金提高迫使抛售，抛售压低价格。

96c7abb97ee1.en: Pause and predict. A leveraged holder owns a large share of an asset's market. News knocks three percent off the price. If it must keep its margin, and margins rise as prices fall, how far can the price end up falling?
96c7abb97ee1.zh: 暂停并预测。一个加杠杆的持有者占某项资产市场的很大份额。一条消息让价格下跌百分之三。如果它必须维持保证金，而保证金又随价格下跌而上升，价格最终会跌多少？

1b188af5d566.en: Chapter two, and the answer to the pause: in this model, about 22 percent, 7 times the shock. Forced sales alone take the price down 14 percent; margins that rise as the price falls take it further. Markus Brunnermeier and Lasse Pedersen called these the loss spiral and the margin spiral.
1b188af5d566.zh: 第2章，以及暂停问题的答案：在这个模型里大约是22%，是冲击的7倍。单是被迫抛售就让价格下跌14%；随价格下跌而上升的保证金让它跌得更深。马库斯·布伦纳迈尔和拉瑟·佩德森把它们称为损失螺旋和保证金螺旋。

5db8e69b7457.en: A minimal version, in the House's spiral function. <bookmark mark='a'/> A holder at five times. <bookmark mark='b'/> Its margin rises as the price falls, by an amount kappa that measures how nervous lenders become. <bookmark mark='c'/> Each round it cuts its position to what its equity can carry, <bookmark mark='d'/> and its sales push the price down, marking everything it still holds lower.
5db8e69b7457.zh: 一个最简版本，就在本系列公司的spiral函数里。<bookmark mark='a'/>一个五倍杠杆的持有者。<bookmark mark='b'/>它的保证金随价格下跌而上升，上升幅度由kappa决定，kappa衡量贷款方变得多紧张。<bookmark mark='c'/>每一轮它都把头寸削减到权益能支撑的水平，<bookmark mark='d'/>而它的抛售压低价格，让它仍持有的一切都按更低的价格计值。

14289f5840e6.en: Two spirals. <bookmark mark='a'/> The loss spiral: a price fall shrinks equity, the holder sells to keep its leverage, and the sale lowers the price again. <bookmark mark='b'/> The margin spiral: lenders facing more uncertainty raise margins, so leverage itself must fall, and the sales are larger still. Both run through the same market, at the same time.
14289f5840e6.zh: 两种螺旋。<bookmark mark='a'/>损失螺旋：价格下跌缩小权益，持有者为维持杠杆而卖出，卖出再次压低价格。<bookmark mark='b'/>保证金螺旋：面对更大不确定性的贷款方提高保证金，于是杠杆本身必须下降，卖出规模更大。两者在同一个市场、同一时间运转。

9b234e0e5e2c.en: The price, round by round, after a three percent shock. <bookmark mark='a'/> With constant margins, each round's sale is smaller than the last, and the price settles 14 percent down. <bookmark mark='b'/> With margins that rise as it falls, the early rounds are larger, and it settles 22 percent down, in fewer rounds.
9b234e0e5e2c.zh: 百分之三的冲击之后，价格一轮接一轮的变化。<bookmark mark='a'/>保证金不变时，每一轮的卖出都比上一轮少，价格最终停在下跌14%的位置。<bookmark mark='b'/>保证金随价格下跌而上升时，前几轮卖得更多，价格停在下跌22%的位置，而且轮数更少。

168938108770.en: By how nervous the lenders are. <bookmark mark='a'/> With fixed margins, a three percent shock becomes 14, and the holder sells 47 of its hundred units. <bookmark mark='b'/> As margins become more sensitive, the fall reaches 23 percent, 7.6 times the news, and the holder sells 87 units: nearly everything, into a market it is itself pushing down.
168938108770.zh: 按贷款方的紧张程度来看。<bookmark mark='a'/>保证金固定时，百分之三的冲击变成14%，持有者卖掉一百单位中的47。<bookmark mark='b'/>随着保证金越来越敏感，下跌达到23%，是消息本身的7.6倍，持有者卖掉87单位：几乎全部，卖进一个正被它自己压低的市场。

4923a758feb7.en: By the size of the news. <bookmark mark='a'/> A one percent shock: the loss spiral turns it into 8 percent, and with the margin spiral, 19. <bookmark mark='b'/> An eight percent shock ends at 27. With nervous lenders, the outcome barely depends on the size of the news: once the spiral starts, it runs until the leverage is gone. That is a tipping point, not a proportional response.
4923a758feb7.zh: 按消息的大小来看。<bookmark mark='a'/>百分之一的冲击：损失螺旋把它变成8%，加上保证金螺旋则是19%。<bookmark mark='b'/>百分之八的冲击最终是27%。贷款方紧张时，结果几乎不取决于消息的大小：螺旋一旦开始，就会一直转到杠杆耗尽。这是一个临界点，而不是成比例的反应。

3ff08f5ff212.en: And by the depth of the market. <bookmark mark='a'/> The deeper the market relative to the forced seller, the smaller the spiral: from 43 percent when the holder is very large to 6 when the market is four times deeper. Crowded trades are dangerous because everyone in them is the large holder.
3ff08f5ff212.zh: 以及按市场深度来看。<bookmark mark='a'/>市场相对于被迫卖家越深，螺旋越小：从持有者非常大时的43%，到市场深四倍时的6%。拥挤的交易之所以危险，是因为身在其中的每个人都是那个大持有者。

d5536626dd17.en: The evidence. <bookmark mark='a'/> Gary Gorton and Andrew Metrick measured haircuts on repo against securitised bonds rising from near zero in early twenty oh seven to around forty-five percent by late twenty oh eight: a run on repo, as a margin spiral. <bookmark mark='b'/> Futures exchanges raise margins after volatility jumps, and in silver in twenty eleven and across markets in March twenty twenty the increases came during the falls, as reported. <bookmark mark='c'/> And the assets hardest to sell and to finance fall furthest: the flight to quality.
d5536626dd17.zh: 证据。<bookmark mark='a'/>加里·戈顿和安德鲁·梅特里克测得，以证券化债券为抵押的回购折扣率从二〇〇七年初接近零，升到二〇〇八年底约百分之四十五：一场回购挤兑，也就是一个保证金螺旋。<bookmark mark='b'/>期货交易所在波动率跳升后提高保证金；据报道，二〇一一年的白银和二〇二〇年三月的各个市场里，提高都发生在下跌之中。<bookmark mark='c'/>最难卖出、最难融资的资产跌得最深：这就是安全投资转移。

bff739ca604e.en: What stops it. <bookmark mark='a'/> A lender of last resort, by Walter Bagehot's rule: lend freely, against good collateral, at a penalty rate. A central bank that accepts the asset at a stable haircut breaks the margin spiral. <bookmark mark='b'/> Margins set through the cycle, so they need not rise as much in the bust. <bookmark mark='c'/> And, in twenty oh eight and twenty twenty, central banks as buyers of last resort, replacing the depth that forced sellers had used up.
bff739ca604e.zh: 什么能让它停下。<bookmark mark='a'/>最后贷款人，遵循沃尔特·白芝浩的规则：自由放贷，接受优质抵押品，收取惩罚性利率。一家以稳定折扣率接受这种资产的中央银行，就能打断保证金螺旋。<bookmark mark='b'/>跨周期设定的保证金，这样在萧条时就不必大幅上调。<bookmark mark='c'/>以及在二〇〇八年和二〇二〇年，中央银行作为最后买家，补上被迫卖家耗尽的市场深度。

765aa110165a.en: Pause and predict. Five chosen banks hold mortgage securities, loans and government bonds at leverage fifteen to thirty. Mortgage values fall five percent. Use the unchanged high-leverage approximation, sales equal leverage times the first loss, and the chosen impact coefficients. How do the resulting second-round marks compare with the first losses? Distinguish this approximation from exact leverage restoration.
765aa110165a.zh: 暂停并预测。五家选定银行持有按揭证券、贷款和国债，杠杆十五至三十倍。按揭价值下跌百分之五。使用保留不改的高杠杆近似，即卖出量等于杠杆乘首次损失，并采用选定冲击系数，第二轮估值损失与首轮相比多大？请与精确恢复杠杆区分。

d6313edacd04.en: Chapter three, and the answer to the pause: comparable. The first loss costs the five banks 34 percent of their equity; the fire sales it forces cost another 28 percent. And for the banks that held few mortgage securities, the fire-sale loss is larger than the one the news itself caused them. The loss travelled through prices, not through any contract between them.
d6313edacd04.zh: 第3章，以及暂停问题的答案：两者相当。最初的损失让五家银行损失了权益的34%；它引发的甩卖又损失了28%。对于持有抵押贷款证券很少的银行，甩卖造成的损失比消息本身造成的还大。损失是通过价格传播的，而不是通过它们之间的任何合约。

175a2e45cd21.en: Andrei Shleifer and Robert Vishny's insight. <bookmark mark='a'/> When an industry's assets must be sold, the buyers who value them most are the industry's own firms, hit by the same shock. <bookmark mark='b'/> So outsiders buy only at a discount: a fire-sale price, below the asset's value in normal times. <bookmark mark='c'/> And because every holder marks the asset at that price, one firm's sale is every firm's loss.
175a2e45cd21.zh: 安德烈·施莱弗和罗伯特·维什尼的洞见。<bookmark mark='a'/>当一个行业的资产必须出售时，最看重这些资产的买家正是这个行业自己的公司，而它们受到了同样的冲击。<bookmark mark='b'/>所以外部人只肯折价买入：一个甩卖价，低于资产在正常时期的价值。<bookmark mark='c'/>又因为每个持有者都按这个价格给资产估值，一家公司的卖出就是每一家公司的损失。

7550dce41f1b.en: A stylized implementation inspired by Greenwood, Landier and Thesmar. <bookmark mark='a'/> The first-round change equals holdings times the asset-return shock. <bookmark mark='b'/> The unchanged code sells leverage times the positive loss, allocated proportionally. This is a high-leverage approximation: exact restoration of the original leverage after a dollar loss, with sale proceeds repaying debt, sells leverage minus one times that loss. <bookmark mark='c'/> Linear price impact depends on dollars sold and chosen illiquidity coefficients. <bookmark mark='d'/> The code marks post-shock holdings at the induced price change, producing a stylized second-round loss, not a full multi-round equilibrium.
7550dce41f1b.zh: 受格林伍德、兰迪耶和泰斯马启发的简化实现。<bookmark mark='a'/>首轮价值变化等于持仓乘资产收益冲击。<bookmark mark='b'/>原代码按杠杆乘正损失卖出，并按持仓比例分配。这是高杠杆近似；若卖出款还债，精确恢复原杠杆应卖杠杆减一乘损失。<bookmark mark='c'/>线性价格冲击取决于卖出金额及选定不流动性系数。<bookmark mark='d'/>代码对冲击后持仓计入诱发价格变化，得到简化第二轮损失，不是完整多轮均衡。

323dbe81778e.en: Five stylised banks. <bookmark mark='a'/> Each holds mortgage securities, loans and government bonds in different proportions, at leverage from fifteen to thirty. <bookmark mark='b'/> Bank D is the most levered and the most exposed to mortgages; bank C holds mostly government bonds. Mortgage securities are the illiquid asset: selling them moves their price ten times more than selling bonds.
323dbe81778e.zh: 五家典型化的银行。<bookmark mark='a'/>每家按不同比例持有抵押贷款证券、贷款和政府债券，杠杆在十五到三十倍之间。<bookmark mark='b'/>D银行杠杆最高，对抵押贷款的敞口最大；C银行主要持有政府债券。抵押贷款证券是流动性差的资产：卖出它们对价格的冲击是卖出债券的十倍。

5325e24906e6.en: A chosen five percent mortgage-security fall. <bookmark mark='a'/> First losses follow the mortgage holdings. <bookmark mark='b'/> Under the unchanged leverage-times-loss approximation, aggregate sales are 1,295 billion dollars. Exact leverage restoration would instead use leverage minus one; we preserve the original outputs and label the approximation. <bookmark mark='c'/> Linear impact then creates second-round marks. Bank E loses 2.5 billion initially and 4.1 in that second round. These are illustrative bank holdings and impact coefficients.
5325e24906e6.zh: 选定按揭证券下跌百分之五。<bookmark mark='a'/>首轮损失随按揭持仓变化。<bookmark mark='b'/>原杠杆乘损失近似给出总卖出1295十亿美元；精确恢复须用杠杆减一。我们保留原数值并说明近似。<bookmark mark='c'/>线性冲击造成第二轮估值损失；E银行初始损失2.5十亿美元，第二轮4.1。持仓与冲击系数均为示例。

2e09198d8aad.en: One number for the system. <bookmark mark='a'/> Aggregate vulnerability: the fire-sale loss as a share of all the banks' equity. <bookmark mark='b'/> Here 28 percent, from a five percent move in one asset. <bookmark mark='c'/> If that asset were twice as hard to sell, 50 percent. Greenwood, Landier and Thesmar applied it to European banks' sovereign holdings in twenty eleven.
2e09198d8aad.zh: 给整个体系的一个数字。<bookmark mark='a'/>总体脆弱度：甩卖损失占所有银行权益的比例。<bookmark mark='b'/>这里是28%，来自一种资产百分之五的变动。<bookmark mark='c'/>如果这种资产难卖一倍，就是50%。格林伍德、兰迪耶和泰斯马把它用在了二〇一一年欧洲银行持有的主权债上。

34f3f10b0f09.en: Evidence from mutual funds. <bookmark mark='a'/> Coval and Stafford studied extreme flows, funds' existing holdings, and the price pressure associated with their forced trades. <bookmark mark='b'/> Subsequent recovery supports the price-pressure interpretation in that research design. Recovery by itself does not identify a purely noninformational discount: common news, selection and changing expected returns must also be considered. <bookmark mark='c'/> Bond-fund stress in March twenty twenty and Archegos block sales provide related episodes, with their own institutions and evidence.
34f3f10b0f09.zh: 共同基金证据。<bookmark mark='a'/>科瓦尔与斯塔福德研究极端资金流、基金既有持仓及被迫交易相关的价格压力。<bookmark mark='b'/>随后价格恢复，在其研究设计中支持价格压力解释；但单看恢复，不能识别纯粹非信息性折价，还须考虑共同消息、选择和预期收益变化。<bookmark mark='c'/>二〇二〇年三月债券基金和Archegos大宗抛售是相关事件，各有不同制度和证据。

c53759fca976.en: The broader lesson. <bookmark mark='a'/> Common holdings are a network: two banks that never lend to each other are linked if they own the same assets, which Rama Cont and Eric Schaanning call price-mediated contagion. <bookmark mark='b'/> So diversification can concentrate: if every bank diversifies into the same assets, each is safer alone and all are exposed to one fire sale. <bookmark mark='c'/> A bank's own stress test misses the others' sales; a system's must include them.
c53759fca976.zh: 更广的教训。<bookmark mark='a'/>共同持仓就是一张网络：两家从不互相借贷的银行，只要持有相同的资产就联系在一起，拉玛·孔特和埃里克·沙宁称之为价格传导的传染。<bookmark mark='b'/>所以分散化反而可能带来集中：如果每家银行都分散投资到同样的资产上，单独看每家都更安全，合起来却都暴露于同一场甩卖。<bookmark mark='c'/>一家银行自己的压力测试看不到别人的抛售；体系的压力测试必须把它们包括进来。

9855760ad3c5.en: Pause and predict. Ten banks each owe the others six dollars in total and have a buffer of half a dollar. Bank one suffers a loss. Is the system safer if each bank owes all nine others a little, or owes only its neighbour?
9855760ad3c5.zh: 暂停并预测。十家银行各自总共欠其他银行六美元，各有半美元的缓冲。一号银行遭受损失。每家银行欠其他九家每家一点，还是只欠它的邻居，哪种体系更安全？

87e414a608af.en: Chapter four. In the chosen symmetric senior-debt model, the effect of links depends on shock size and interbank debt relative to the buffer. With no more than a half-dollar shock, nobody defaults. Above that and up to five, only the directly hit bank defaults in the complete network. Above five all ten default for our chosen debt level. This phase transition is conditional on the model; it does not rank every real network or imply that one bank must fail after any arbitrarily small loss.
87e414a608af.zh: 第4章。在选定对称优先债务模型里，网络作用取决于冲击大小及银行间债务相对缓冲的规模。冲击不超过半元时无人违约；超过半元但不超过五时，完全网络只有受冲击者违约；超过五时，在选定债务水平下十家全违约。相变有模型条件，不能排列所有真实网络，也不表示任意小损失都必使一家倒下。

619488e9add7.en: How interbank payments clear, after Larry Eisenberg and Thomas Noe. <bookmark mark='a'/> Each bank owes a total to the others. <bookmark mark='b'/> A defaulter pays its creditors in proportion to what it owes them. <bookmark mark='c'/> And each bank pays in full, or pays everything it has: its outside assets plus what the others pay it. A clearing vector solves every bank's equation at once.
619488e9add7.zh: 银行间支付如何清算，依照拉里·艾森伯格和托马斯·诺伊的模型。<bookmark mark='a'/>每家银行对其他银行有一笔总欠款。<bookmark mark='b'/>违约者按所欠比例向债权人支付。<bookmark mark='c'/>每家银行要么全额支付，要么付出它拥有的全部：外部资产加上其他银行付给它的钱。清算向量同时满足每家银行的方程。

06eecd1a11b0.en: Five banks. <bookmark mark='a'/> Arrows are debts, thicker for larger; each bank also holds some outside assets. <bookmark mark='b'/> The fictitious default algorithm starts by assuming everyone pays, finds who cannot, recomputes, and stops: here after 2 rounds. Bank A, with little outside, pays 3.5 of its 5; the shortfall passes to its creditors, who absorb it.
06eecd1a11b0.zh: 五家银行。<bookmark mark='a'/>箭头是债务，越粗越大；每家银行还持有一些外部资产。<bookmark mark='b'/>虚拟违约算法先假设所有人都付款，找出付不了的，重新计算，然后停下：这里用了2轮。外部资产很少的A银行在它欠的5中支付了3.5；缺口传给它的债权人，由他们吸收。

7dc72878adc0.en: A sharper version. <bookmark mark='a'/> Each bank holds a project worth a, owes v to senior outside creditors first, and y to other banks; one bank takes a shock epsilon. <bookmark mark='b'/> A minus v is each bank's buffer. <bookmark mark='c'/> And the same total interbank debt can be arranged as a ring, each owing only its neighbour; as a complete network, each owing all the others a little; or as clusters.
7dc72878adc0.zh: 一个更锐利的版本。<bookmark mark='a'/>每家银行持有一个价值为a的项目，先欠外部优先债权人v，再欠其他银行y；一家银行受到冲击epsilon。<bookmark mark='b'/>a减v是每家银行的缓冲。<bookmark mark='c'/>同样的银行间总债务可以排成环形，每家只欠邻居；排成完全网络，每家欠其他所有银行一点；或者排成几个簇。

997f3cc084cc.en: Ten banks, each owing six to the others and with a buffer of half a dollar. <bookmark mark='a'/> In the ring, defaults climb step by step with the shock: each failure passes the loss to the next bank. <bookmark mark='b'/> In the complete network, nothing spreads at all, until the shock passes five, and then all ten fail together.
997f3cc084cc.zh: 十家银行，各自欠其他银行六，缓冲半美元。<bookmark mark='a'/>在环形网络里，违约随冲击一步步增加：每一次倒闭都把损失传给下一家。<bookmark mark='b'/>在完全网络里，什么都不扩散，直到冲击超过五，然后十家一起倒下。

34ffcdd209fe.en: Why five for these chosen parameters. <bookmark mark='a'/> Let b equal a minus v, positive. The hit bank defaults only when epsilon exceeds b. <bookmark mark='b'/> If all other banks pay, its interbank shortfall is the smaller of y and the positive part of epsilon minus b. That shortfall is shared among n minus one creditors. <bookmark mark='c'/> If y exceeds n minus one times b, a sufficiently large hit can breach every creditor's buffer, giving the threshold epsilon above n b. Here y is six, exceeding nine times a half. Below the half-dollar buffer there is no default; up to five, only one; above five, all ten. Without the debt-size condition, this conclusion need not hold.
34ffcdd209fe.zh: 为何本例恰为五。<bookmark mark='a'/>令正缓冲b等于a减v；受冲击银行仅在epsilon大于b时违约。<bookmark mark='b'/>其他银行全额支付时，其银行间短缺为y与epsilon减b正部的较小者，均分给其余n减一家。<bookmark mark='c'/>若y大于n减一乘b，足够大的冲击才能击穿每家债权人的缓冲，阈值为epsilon大于nb。这里y为六，大于九乘半元。半元以内无违约，至五仅一家，再大则十家全违约。若债务规模条件不满足，结论可失败。

10e0807f1aa4.en: The third chosen network has two groups of five and a two-percent cross-group share. <bookmark mark='a'/> Over this finite shock grid, the maximum default count is 5. The weak link limits transmission in this example. That is not a universal five-bank cap or a global ranking of all clustered networks. The literature's comparisons depend on the admissible network class, liabilities, buffers and shock regime.
10e0807f1aa4.zh: 第三个选定网络由两组五家组成，跨组份额百分之二。<bookmark mark='a'/>在此有限冲击网格上，最多5家违约。弱连接在本例限制传播，但这不是普遍五家上限，也不是对所有分组网络的全局排名。文献比较取决于允许的网络类别、债务、缓冲与冲击区间。

840b88e7a9de.en: And real networks. <bookmark mark='a'/> They are core and periphery: a few large dealers linked to everyone, robust to random failures and fragile to the failure of a hub. <bookmark mark='b'/> Simulations on supervisors' interbank data found direct contagion rarely large on its own, as surveys reported: it is the combination with fire sales and runs that bites. <bookmark mark='c'/> And central clearing, Part twenty-one, replaced many bilateral links with one hub per market.
840b88e7a9de.zh: 以及真实的网络。<bookmark mark='a'/>它们是核心—边缘结构：少数大型交易商与所有人相连，对随机倒闭很稳健，对枢纽倒闭很脆弱。<bookmark mark='b'/>据综述报道，用监管机构的银行间数据所做的模拟发现，单靠直接传染很少造成大的损失：真正伤人的是它与甩卖和挤兑的组合。<bookmark mark='c'/>而中央清算，第21部分，把许多双边联系换成了每个市场一个枢纽。

c0a98ddbae8a.en: Pause and predict. Three financial industries: banks, insurers and other finance. Which matters most for the market in a crash: the one that falls the most, or the one whose distress moves the market the most?
c0a98ddbae8a.zh: 暂停并预测。三个金融行业：银行、保险公司和其他金融机构。在股灾中，对市场最重要的是哪一个：跌得最多的那个，还是陷入困境时最能拖动市场的那个？

ba06ad3153f7.en: Chapter five. These are different descriptive questions. In the selected market's worst five-percent days, other-finance returns average a 3.8-percent loss and insurers a 2.7-percent loss. Fitted delta CoVaR instead compares the system quantile at an industry's tail and median state, and gives a different ranking. Exposure and conditional association are distinct; neither industry regression identifies a causal contribution to a crisis.
ba06ad3153f7.zh: 第5章。这是不同的描述性问题。在市场选定最差百分之五日期，其他金融业平均损失3.8%，保险业2.7%。拟合ΔCoVaR则比较系统在行业尾部状态与中位状态的条件分位数，排名不同。敞口和条件关联有别；行业回归都不能识别对危机的因果贡献。

f5d02b294805.en: CoVaR, after Adrian and Brunnermeier. <bookmark mark='a'/> In a correctly specified continuous conditional model, it is the system-return quantile at a chosen institution-return state. Conditioning on an exact return is defined through that conditional distribution, not by selecting observations equal to one number. <bookmark mark='b'/> Here a linear quantile regression is approximated by finite iteratively reweighted least squares. Specification and numerical error remain. <bookmark mark='c'/> Delta CoVaR is the fitted difference between institution tail and median states. It is a conditional association, not an identified causal effect.
f5d02b294805.zh: 阿德里安与布伦纳迈尔的CoVaR。<bookmark mark='a'/>在正确设定的连续条件模型中，它是指定机构收益状态下的系统收益分位数。精确状态条件由条件分布定义，不是挑出收益恰等于某数字的观测。<bookmark mark='b'/>这里以有限次迭代重加权最小二乘近似线性分位回归，仍有设定与数值误差。<bookmark mark='c'/>ΔCoVaR为机构尾部状态与中位状态的拟合差，是条件关联，不是识别出的因果效应。

4c0fb3786eea.en: Retrospective daily data from nineteen ninety to twenty twenty, with industry portfolios standing in for firms. <bookmark mark='a'/> The fitted market five-percent quantile difference is -1.29 percentage points for banks, -1.37 for insurers and -1.45 for other finance. <bookmark mark='b'/> MES instead averages each industry's return on the market's worst days. These rankings differ because the conditioning questions differ. The estimates have sampling and specification uncertainty and are not causal effects of putting an institution into distress.
4c0fb3786eea.zh: 一九九〇至二〇二〇年的回顾性日数据，行业组合代理公司。<bookmark mark='a'/>拟合市场百分之五分位数差：银行-1.29个百分点、保险-1.37、其他金融-1.45。<bookmark mark='b'/>MES则平均市场最差日期中各行业收益。条件问题不同，所以排名不同。估计包含抽样与设定不确定性，不是使某机构陷入困境的因果效应。

ac61b2007d1f.en: Over time, in two-year windows. <bookmark mark='a'/> All three are quiet in calm years and plunge together in the crises: the deepest reading, -3.3 percent, comes in the window around twenty oh eight. <bookmark mark='b'/> A systemic measure built from market prices sees the crisis as it arrives, which makes it a thermometer more than a forecast.
ac61b2007d1f.zh: 随时间变化，按两年窗口计算。<bookmark mark='a'/>三者在平静年份都很安静，在危机中一起骤降：最深的读数-3.3%出现在二〇〇八年前后的窗口里。<bookmark mark='b'/>用市场价格构建的系统性度量是在危机到来时看见它，所以它更像一支温度计，而不是一个预测。

065ea9bf920f.en: Exposure is a different question. <bookmark mark='a'/> This chapter defines MES as average institution return on the market's worst five percent of days, usually a negative number. Its connection to a portfolio ES contribution needs suitable linear-loss and smooth-tail conditions. <bookmark mark='b'/> For the long-run heuristic, switch signs to a positive loss m, then use one minus exp of minus eighteen m. The customary motivation uses a two-percent daily tail; our unchanged illustration feeds it a five-percent industry proxy. <bookmark mark='c'/> A chosen three-percent positive loss maps to roughly forty-two percent. It does not validate a firm-specific six-month crisis forecast.
065ea9bf920f.zh: 敞口是另一问题。<bookmark mark='a'/>这里MES是市场最差百分之五日期的机构平均收益，通常为负。它与组合ES贡献的联系需要线性损失及平滑尾部等条件。<bookmark mark='b'/>长期启发式先改为正损失m，再用一减exp负十八m；常见动机使用百分之二日尾部，而原例输入百分之五行业代理。<bookmark mark='c'/>选定百分之三正损失映射为约百分之四十二，并不验证某公司六个月危机预测。

9879a074c403.en: SRISK, after Brownlees and Engle. <bookmark mark='a'/> For debt D, market equity E and a crisis loss fraction L, shortfall is k D minus one minus k times one minus L times E. The one-minus-k factor is essential. <bookmark mark='b'/> We choose k equal to eight percent; that is a modeling parameter here, not a certification of current capital requirements. <bookmark mark='c'/> For aggregate capital need, sum positive shortfalls rather than netting surpluses across firms. The debt, equity and crisis-loss inputs must match the intended model.
9879a074c403.zh: 布朗利斯与恩格尔的SRISK。<bookmark mark='a'/>债务D、市值权益E、危机损失比例L下，短缺为kD减一减k乘一减L乘E；一减k不可遗漏。<bookmark mark='b'/>本例选择k为百分之八，这是建模参数，不认证现行资本要求。<bookmark mark='c'/>加总系统资本需要时，应加各家短缺正部，而不是跨公司净掉盈余。债务、权益和危机损失输入须匹配模型。

e6f80f360fc5.en: An explicitly approximate Lehman illustration. <bookmark mark='a'/> Its reported fiscal year-end balance sheet has six hundred ninety-one billion dollars of assets and twenty-two point five billion of book equity. <bookmark mark='b'/> We use other-finance industry returns on the market's worst five percent of two thousand seven days, a positive loss input of 4.0 percent. <bookmark mark='c'/> The heuristic maps this to 51 percent. <bookmark mark='d'/> Inserting it and book equity gives 43 billion dollars. Because both industry MES and book equity replace firm-specific market inputs, this is not standard estimated Lehman SRISK or a validated advance capital forecast.
e6f80f360fc5.zh: 明确近似的雷曼例子。<bookmark mark='a'/>报告的财年末资产六千九百一十亿美元，账面权益二百二十五亿美元。<bookmark mark='b'/>使用二〇〇七年市场最差百分之五日期的其他金融行业收益，正损失输入4.0%。<bookmark mark='c'/>启发式映射为51%。<bookmark mark='d'/>再代入账面权益得到43十亿美元。行业MES和账面权益都替代公司级市场输入，因此不是标准雷曼SRISK估计，也不是经验证的事前资本预测。

a8c93fee7910.en: In the historical policy framework. <bookmark mark='a'/> Since twenty eleven the Financial Stability Board has published an annual list of global systemically important banks using five indicator categories: size, interconnectedness, substitutability, complexity and cross-border activity. These are categories containing multiple indicators, not just five measured variables. <bookmark mark='b'/> The Basel bucket framework specifies additional capital surcharges, including levels from one to three and a half percentage points; implementation and occupied buckets are separate questions. <bookmark mark='c'/> Published market measures such as SRISK offer another perspective for listed firms, under their own model and data assumptions.
a8c93fee7910.zh: 历史政策框架。<bookmark mark='a'/>自二〇一一年起，金融稳定理事会每年发布全球系统重要性银行名单，采用规模、关联性、可替代性、复杂性和跨境活动五类指标。这些类别各包含多项指标，并非只有五个测量变量。<bookmark mark='b'/>巴塞尔分档框架规定额外资本附加要求，包括一至三点五个百分点等水平；实际实施和已占用档位是另两个问题。<bookmark mark='c'/>SRISK等公开市场度量从另一个角度分析上市公司，但依赖其自身模型和数据假设。

3d10331c45cb.en: Limits of these measurements. <bookmark mark='a'/> Our full-sample and two-year windows describe realized stress. Establishing advance predictive information would require a separate past-measurable out-of-sample design; market prices are not inherently devoid of forward-looking information. <bookmark mark='b'/> A high delta CoVaR may reflect transmission or shared exposures; this regression alone cannot separate them. <bookmark mark='c'/> Many funds have observable prices, but coverage, valuation frequency and financing exposures differ. Missing bilateral data and delayed marks remain substantial limits.
3d10331c45cb.zh: 度量的限制。<bookmark mark='a'/>全样本及两年窗口描述已实现压力。事前预测信息需要另设仅用过去信息的样本外设计；不能说市场价格本来就没有前瞻信息。<bookmark mark='b'/>高ΔCoVaR可能来自传染或共同敞口，回归自身不能分离。<bookmark mark='c'/>很多基金有可见价格，但覆盖、估值频率和融资敞口不同；双边数据缺失和延迟估值仍很重要。

e3cf58f388af.en: Pause and predict. In early nineteen ninety-eight a hedge fund held about a hundred and twenty-five billion dollars of assets on four point seven billion of capital, mostly in trades betting that spreads would narrow. What move would have wiped it out, and who would have had to sell?
e3cf58f388af.zh: 暂停并预测。一九九八年初，一家对冲基金以四十七亿美元的资本持有约一千二百五十亿美元的资产，主要是押注利差会收窄的交易。多大的变动会让它清零，谁又不得不卖出？

9497298c415c.en: Chapter six. Dividing reported capital of four point seven billion dollars by assets of one hundred twenty-five billion gives 3.8 percent. A uniform asset-value fall of that size exhausts equity under fixed debt, at 27 times leverage. It is not a spread-basis-point threshold or a full derivatives loss model: those need duration, convexity, offsets and financing terms. Common positions and counterparty exposures made a rapid liquidation dangerous, helping motivate a privately financed recapitalization facilitated by the New York Fed.
9497298c415c.zh: 第6章。报告资本四十七亿美元除资产一千二百五十亿美元为3.8%。固定债务、27倍杠杆下，均匀资产价值下跌此比例耗尽权益。但它不是利差基点阈值，也不是完整衍生品损失模型；后者需要久期、凸性、抵销和融资条款。共同持仓与对手方敞口使快速清算危险，促成纽约联储协调的私人注资。

fb7e4c9fe3ad.en: The book as historically reported. <bookmark mark='a'/> One hundred twenty-five billion dollars of assets and four point seven billion of capital. <bookmark mark='b'/> That is about 27 times balance-sheet leverage. <bookmark mark='c'/> Gross derivatives notional was about one point two five trillion dollars. Notional measures contractual scale, not net market exposure or a loss amount, and cannot simply be added to balance-sheet assets. <bookmark mark='d'/> Positions included convergence trades between related securities. Their risks depended on sensitivities, basis, crowding and financing, rather than the apparent small spread alone.
fb7e4c9fe3ad.zh: 历史报告中的账簿。<bookmark mark='a'/>资产一千二百五十亿美元，资本四十七亿美元。<bookmark mark='b'/>表内杠杆约为27倍。<bookmark mark='c'/>衍生品总名义金额约一万二千五百亿美元。名义金额衡量合同规模，并非净市场敞口或损失金额，不能直接加到表内资产。<bookmark mark='d'/>持仓包括相关证券间的收敛交易。其风险取决于敏感度、基差、拥挤程度和融资条件，不能只看似乎很小的价差。

5dd4e1ac35d1.en: Why apparently diversified positions can suffer together. <bookmark mark='a'/> Other funds and dealers held similar relative-value positions, making liquidation crowded. <bookmark mark='b'/> Russia's August nineteen ninety-eight default accompanied a broad flight toward liquidity; many convergence positions lost together. This is not evidence that every spread widened or every correlation equaled one. <bookmark mark='c'/> Shared funding and liquidation exposure can connect positions across countries and asset classes, even without identical underlying cash flows.
5dd4e1ac35d1.zh: 貌似分散的持仓为何一起受损。<bookmark mark='a'/>其他基金和交易商持有相近相对价值头寸，使退出拥挤。<bookmark mark='b'/>一九九八年八月俄罗斯违约伴随避险流动性需求，多种趋同交易同时亏损；不等于每个利差都扩大、每个相关系数都为一。<bookmark mark='c'/>共同融资和清算敞口能跨国家、资产类别连接头寸，即使基础现金流不同。

5131be997e2e.en: One descriptive public yield difference. <bookmark mark='a'/> Baa corporate yields minus the ten-year Treasury were near 1.7 percentage points at the selected early-August observation. <bookmark mark='b'/> The difference reached 2.8, while the Treasury yield's annual minimum was 4.16 percent. Those peaks and lows need not occur on the same day. The series combines credit, liquidity and maturity effects; it is not LTCM's complete book or evidence that every convergence trade had identical exposure.
5131be997e2e.zh: 一项描述性的公开收益率差。<bookmark mark='a'/>在选定的八月初观察日，Baa企业债减十年期国债收益率约为1.7个百分点。<bookmark mark='b'/>这一差值达到2.8，十年期国债收益率的年度最低值为4.16%。这些极值不一定发生在同一天。该序列混合信用、流动性和期限效应，并非LTCM的完整账簿，也不能证明每笔收敛交易都具有相同敞口。

dddbbdde8f44.en: The resolution. <bookmark mark='a'/> On the twenty-third of September, fourteen banks, convened by the New York Fed, put in three point six billion dollars for ninety percent of the fund, with no public money lent, as the Fed testified. <bookmark mark='b'/> They agreed because liquidating the book at once would have forced all of them to sell the same positions into the same market: a coordinated fire sale avoided. <bookmark mark='c'/> And the Fed cut rates three times that autumn, a precedent debated for a decade.
dddbbdde8f44.zh: 结局。<bookmark mark='a'/>九月二十三日，在纽约联储召集下，十四家银行投入三十六亿美元换取基金百分之九十的股份；据美联储的国会证词，没有借出任何公共资金。<bookmark mark='b'/>它们同意，是因为一次性清算整本账簿会迫使它们所有人把同样的头寸卖进同一个市场：一场协调起来避免了的甩卖。<bookmark mark='c'/>美联储在那个秋天三次降息，这个先例被争论了十年。

dde6caa6c9f7.en: Three lessons. <bookmark mark='a'/> Thin equity amplifies asset losses. The roughly four-percent uniform-loss calculation is a balance-sheet bridge, not a reconstruction of LTCM's actual trading losses. <bookmark mark='b'/> Each lender saw only part of the aggregate book, complicating counterparty risk management. <bookmark mark='c'/> Funding and liquidation can be common risk factors. Calm-window risk estimates can miss their stressed behavior; neither diversification nor a low recent VaR proves that exit liquidity will remain available.
dde6caa6c9f7.zh: 三个教训。<bookmark mark='a'/>薄权益放大资产损失；约百分之四均匀损失只是资产负债表桥梁，不是LTCM实际亏损重建。<bookmark mark='b'/>各贷款方只见整体账簿一部分，增加对手方管理困难。<bookmark mark='c'/>融资和清算可以是共同因子。平静窗口估计可能漏掉压力行为；分散化或近期低VaR都不证明退出流动性仍在。

fe0cd306a6d4.en: Pause and predict. The TED spread, the gap between three-month interbank lending rates and Treasury bills, averaged under half a percentage point before twenty oh seven. How high did it go in October twenty oh eight, and what does it measure?
fe0cd306a6d4.zh: 暂停并预测。TED利差，即三个月期银行间拆借利率与国库券之间的差，在二〇〇七年之前平均不到半个百分点。它在二〇〇八年十月升到多高，它衡量的是什么？

306d2b1a4fb4.en: Chapter seven. The TED spread reaches 4.58 percentage points on 20081010, compared with a roughly 0.46 median over the first two hundred fifty observations. It is three-month dollar LIBOR minus the Treasury-bill yield. Bank credit risk, term funding liquidity and demand for Treasury safety all affect it. Calling it pure trust or a default probability would discard those components.
306d2b1a4fb4.zh: 第7章。TED利差在20081010达到4.58个百分点，前二百五十个观测的中位约0.46。它是三个月美元LIBOR减国库券收益率，受银行信用、期限融资流动性和避险国库券需求影响。把它称作纯信任或违约概率，会忽略这些成分。

9f1c440a7498.en: A stylized funding chain. <bookmark mark='a'/> Mortgages were pooled and sliced into different-risk securities and tranches. <bookmark mark='b'/> Dealers, conduits, investment vehicles and funds held different instruments; money funds often supplied short funding rather than holding the same mortgage assets directly. <bookmark mark='c'/> Repo and commercial paper financed longer assets. Ordinary deposit insurance did not cover these wholesale claims, although bank backstops and eventual emergency support varied. <bookmark mark='d'/> Credit derivatives transferred some credit risk. AIG's collateral calls could follow market-value changes as well as rating downgrades, under the contracts' terms.
9f1c440a7498.zh: 简化融资链。<bookmark mark='a'/>按揭被汇集、分割成不同风险证券与分层。<bookmark mark='b'/>交易商、通道、投资工具与基金持有不同工具；货币基金常提供短期融资，并非都直接持有同样按揭。<bookmark mark='c'/>回购和商业票据为长期资产融资，普通存款保险不覆盖这些批发债权，但银行支持与后续紧急援助各异。<bookmark mark='d'/>信用衍生品转移部分风险；AIG抵押品追加可由市值变化和评级下降触发，取决于合同。

b767d2cbc143.en: Two FRED yield differences. <bookmark mark='a'/> TED rose during several funding-stress episodes, including August two thousand seven and the period after Lehman's failure. Its components include bank credit and liquidity risk and Treasury-bill safe-haven demand. <bookmark mark='b'/> Baa yields minus the ten-year Treasury move from a roughly 1.7-point early median to a 6.2-point peak. That difference also contains liquidity and maturity effects; it is not a matched-maturity credit-default-swap spread. Two plotted series do not identify a causal sequence from funding to credit losses.
b767d2cbc143.zh: 两个FRED收益率差。<bookmark mark='a'/>TED在二〇〇七年八月及雷曼倒闭后等融资压力期间上升，包含银行信用、流动性与国库券避险需求。<bookmark mark='b'/>Baa减十年期国债从早期约1.7个百分点中位升至6.2峰值；还含流动性与期限效应，不是期限匹配的CDS利差。两条序列不能识别融资压力导致信用损失的因果次序。

c30d2844f0ba.en: The sequence, from the public record. <bookmark mark='a'/> August twenty oh seven: BNP Paribas freezes three funds, and interbank rates jump. <bookmark mark='b'/> March twenty oh eight: Bear Stearns cannot roll its repo and is sold to JPMorgan with Federal Reserve support. <bookmark mark='c'/> September: the government takes over Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac, and Lehman files for bankruptcy on the fifteenth. <bookmark mark='d'/> The next day, AIG's collateral calls bring an eighty-five billion dollar Fed loan, and a money market fund breaks the buck. <bookmark mark='e'/> In October, public capital and guarantees.
c30d2844f0ba.zh: 依据公开记录的时间线。<bookmark mark='a'/>二〇〇七年八月：法国巴黎银行冻结三只基金，银行间利率跳升。<bookmark mark='b'/>二〇〇八年三月：贝尔斯登无法续做回购，在美联储支持下被出售给摩根大通。<bookmark mark='c'/>九月：政府接管房利美和房地美，雷曼在十五日申请破产。<bookmark mark='d'/>第二天，AIG的追加抵押品要求换来美联储八百五十亿美元的贷款，一只货币市场基金跌破面值。<bookmark mark='e'/>十月，公共资本注入和担保。

56e98ae7d8be.en: Two failures, two mechanisms. <bookmark mark='a'/> Lehman, at about thirty-one times, with much of its funding overnight, lost its lenders over a weekend, and its failure froze its prime-brokerage clients' assets in London, as reported. <bookmark mark='b'/> AIG had sold protection on hundreds of billions of senior tranches; downgrades and falling prices triggered collateral calls it could not meet. <bookmark mark='c'/> Both were Chapter one's arithmetic: thin equity, and lenders demanding more exactly when it was scarcest.
56e98ae7d8be.zh: 两次倒闭，两种机制。<bookmark mark='a'/>据报道，雷曼的杠杆约为三十一倍，大量融资是隔夜的，它在一个周末之内失去了贷款方，它的倒闭冻结了伦敦主经纪业务客户的资产。<bookmark mark='b'/>AIG为数千亿美元的优先级分级出售了保护；降级和价格下跌触发了它无法满足的追加抵押品要求。<bookmark mark='c'/>两者都是第1章的算术：单薄的权益，以及贷款方恰恰在权益最稀缺时要求更多。

b1280323aee2.en: Runs can also reach cash-management funds. <bookmark mark='a'/> Many money market funds sought a stable one-dollar net asset value with daily redemption; that target was not an insured bank-deposit promise. <bookmark mark='b'/> The Reserve Primary Fund's Lehman exposure contributed to its breaking the buck in September two thousand eight. <bookmark mark='c'/> Large redemptions from prime funds impaired commercial-paper funding. The Treasury's temporary guarantee and Federal Reserve liquidity programs were separate emergency interventions, rather than proof that fund shares had always been insured.
b1280323aee2.zh: 现金管理基金也可遭遇挤兑。<bookmark mark='a'/>许多货币基金追求一美元稳定净值并每日赎回，但不是受保存款承诺。<bookmark mark='b'/>储备首要基金的雷曼敞口促使其在二〇〇八年九月跌破面值。<bookmark mark='c'/>优质货币基金的大额赎回影响商业票据融资。财政部临时担保和联储流动性项目是不同紧急措施，不证明基金份额一贯有保险。

729d416f38ec.en: The response. <bookmark mark='a'/> The Fed lent to dealers, money funds and commercial-paper issuers, then bought mortgage securities outright: lender, then buyer, of last resort. <bookmark mark='b'/> Governments put capital into the banks, and from twenty oh nine stress tests told markets how much each needed. <bookmark mark='c'/> And the rules that followed: Basel three's capital and liquidity ratios, central clearing, resolution plans and surcharges for the systemic banks.
729d416f38ec.zh: 应对。<bookmark mark='a'/>美联储向交易商、货币基金和商业票据发行人放贷，然后直接买入抵押贷款证券：先是最后贷款人，然后是最后买家。<bookmark mark='b'/>各国政府向银行注资，从二〇〇九年起，压力测试告诉市场每家银行需要多少资本。<bookmark mark='c'/>以及随后的规则：巴塞尔协议三的资本和流动性比率、中央清算、处置计划，以及对系统重要性银行的附加资本。

9aea98cd4343.en: Pause and predict. Between the ninth and the eighteenth of March twenty twenty, American stocks fell sharply. What happened to the yield of the ten-year Treasury, the world's safest asset, and why?
9aea98cd4343.zh: 暂停并预测。二〇二〇年三月九日到十八日之间，美国股市大跌。世界上最安全的资产，十年期美国国债，它的收益率发生了什么，为什么？

5065e0838f53.en: Chapter eight. The ten-year Treasury yield rises from 0.54 percent on March ninth to 1.18 on March eighteenth, twenty twenty, while stocks fall. Treasuries often attract safe-haven demand, but urgent cash needs can also induce sales of liquid government securities. Official reviews describe several selling sectors and constrained intermediation. This price co-movement motivates those mechanisms; by itself it does not identify every seller or prove one cause.
5065e0838f53.zh: 第8章。二〇二〇年三月九日至十八日，股市下跌时，十年国债收益率从0.54%升至1.18%。国债常吸引避险需求，但紧急现金需求也会促使卖出流动国债。官方复盘描述多个卖方部门与中介约束。共同价格变化引出这些机制，本身不能识别所有卖方或证明单一原因。

19d302f3b004.en: Two charts from public data. <bookmark mark='a'/> On the right, American stocks: down about 31 percent from the start of February at the low. <bookmark mark='b'/> On the left, the ten-year Treasury yield. Through February it falls, as it should: a flight to safety. <bookmark mark='c'/> Then, in the week of the ninth to the eighteenth of March, it rises as stocks keep falling. The safe asset was being sold.
19d302f3b004.zh: 两张来自公开数据的图。<bookmark mark='a'/>右边是美国股市：在低点时比二月初下跌了约31%。<bookmark mark='b'/>左边是十年期国债收益率。整个二月它在下降，这很正常：安全投资转移。<bookmark mark='c'/>然后，在三月九日到十八日这一周，股市继续下跌，它却上升了。安全资产正在被抛售。

8340dad163b8.en: Official reviews describe several sellers. <bookmark mark='a'/> Foreign official holders sold Treasuries while seeking dollar liquidity. <bookmark mark='b'/> Open-end funds sold liquid holdings to meet redemptions. <bookmark mark='c'/> Some leveraged relative-value funds unwound cash-futures positions. <bookmark mark='d'/> Dealer intermediation capacity faced risk-management, balance-sheet and regulatory constraints. The supplementary leverage ratio was one constraint, not a complete causal explanation, and funding terms did not tighten identically for every trader.
8340dad163b8.zh: 官方复盘中的多个卖方。<bookmark mark='a'/>外国官方持有者寻求美元流动性时卖出国债。<bookmark mark='b'/>开放式基金为赎回卖出流动持仓。<bookmark mark='c'/>部分杠杆相对价值基金平仓现券期货头寸。<bookmark mark='d'/>交易商受到风险管理、资产负债表和监管限制。补充杠杆率只是一个因素，不是完整因果解释；融资条件也不是所有交易者同步收紧。

c8fc70602664.en: A Treasury cash-futures basis trade. <bookmark mark='a'/> Buy a cash bond using repo financing, often at high leverage. <bookmark mark='b'/> Short Treasury futures with approximately offsetting duration. <bookmark mark='c'/> Futures minus cash minus carry is shorthand: actual pricing needs the conversion factor, cheapest-to-deliver bond, delivery options and repo specials. The residual basis is not a riskless few basis points. <bookmark mark='d'/> Variation margin, basis movements, residual duration and financing rollover can all force cash needs. Some traders faced tighter funding; a universal increase in every repo haircut is not established here.
c8fc70602664.zh: 国债现券期货基差交易。<bookmark mark='a'/>用回购买入现券，常有高杠杆。<bookmark mark='b'/>做空久期大致抵销的国债期货。<bookmark mark='c'/>期货减现券减持有成本只是简写，实际定价须考虑转换因子、最便宜可交割券、交割期权及特殊回购利率，剩余基差并非无风险几个基点。<bookmark mark='d'/>变动保证金、基差变化、剩余久期和融资展期都可能产生现金需求。部分交易者融资收紧，但不能说所有回购折扣率都上升。

45860e82d990.en: Funding stress, again. <bookmark mark='a'/> Three-month commercial paper went from 1.59 percent in mid-February to 2.53, even as the Fed cut rates to zero: a market that had stopped working. <bookmark mark='b'/> And the Baa credit spread roughly doubled, to 4.31 points. Prime money funds again lost billions in days, as in twenty oh eight.
45860e82d990.zh: 又是融资压力。<bookmark mark='a'/>三个月期商业票据利率从二月中旬的1.59%升到2.53%，而美联储正把利率降到零：一个已经停止运转的市场。<bookmark mark='b'/>Baa信用利差大约翻倍，达到4.31个百分点。优质货币基金又在几天内流失了数十亿美元，就像二〇〇八年一样。

5b8b6f27a712.en: The response came in days, not months. <bookmark mark='a'/> On the fifteenth: rates to zero, seven hundred billion dollars of purchases, cheaper dollar swap lines. <bookmark mark='b'/> Then the twenty oh eight facilities, revived in two days. <bookmark mark='c'/> On the twenty-third, purchases in whatever amounts were needed, and for the first time corporate bonds. <bookmark mark='d'/> A repo facility so foreign central banks could borrow against Treasuries rather than sell them. <bookmark mark='e'/> And relief from the leverage ratio, so dealers could hold them. The yield fell back, and stocks bottomed on the twenty-third.
5b8b6f27a712.zh: 应对以天计，而不是以月计。<bookmark mark='a'/>十五日：利率降到零，七千亿美元的购买，更便宜的美元互换额度。<bookmark mark='b'/>然后，二〇〇八年的那些便利工具在两天内重新启用。<bookmark mark='c'/>二十三日，按所需的任何数量购买，并且第一次购买公司债。<bookmark mark='d'/>一个回购便利工具，让外国中央银行可以用国债抵押借款，而不必卖出。<bookmark mark='e'/>以及杠杆比率的豁免，让交易商能够持有国债。收益率回落，股市在二十三日见底。

24124118894d.en: Compare carefully chosen episodes. <bookmark mark='a'/> The acute March twenty twenty disruption included Treasury, money-fund and commercial-paper markets; two thousand eight involved a broader credit and banking crisis. <bookmark mark='b'/> Twenty twenty was not a world without losses: pandemic news changed expected cash flows and asset values while urgent cash needs disrupted trading. <bookmark mark='c'/> Dealer capacity and financing mattered alongside capital, risk management and market structure. <bookmark mark='d'/> Acute Treasury dysfunction eased after extensive interventions, but comparing two weeks with an eighteen-month financial crisis mixes definitions. These charts cannot isolate the interventions' causal effect or certify the status of later market reforms.
24124118894d.zh: 谨慎比较选定事件。<bookmark mark='a'/>二〇二〇年三月急性压力涉及国债、货币基金和商业票据；二〇〇八年是更广泛信用与银行危机。<bookmark mark='b'/>二〇二〇年并非无人亏损，疫情改变预期现金流与资产价值，同时现金需求扰乱交易。<bookmark mark='c'/>交易商能力和融资与资本、风控、市场结构共同作用。<bookmark mark='d'/>大量干预后国债急性失灵缓解，但把两周与十八个月危机相比混淆定义。图表不能分离干预因果效应，也不认证后续改革的当前状态。

ccd1288eb769.en: Pause and predict. From the middle of twenty fourteen, China's Shanghai Composite index more than doubled in a year, much of the buying done with borrowed money. How far did it fall, and how fast?
ccd1288eb769.zh: 暂停并预测。从二〇一四年年中开始，中国的上证综合指数在一年内涨了一倍多，大量买入是用借来的钱完成的。它跌了多少，跌得多快？

f51051a2fd43.en: Chapter nine. The observed Shanghai Composite peak is 5,166; the subsequent low in the original eighty-observation search is 2,927, a 43 percent fall in roughly eleven weeks. Account-level studies separately document margin constraints and forced selling. This aggregate index chart alone does not identify the fraction of the decline caused by margin calls.
f51051a2fd43.zh: 第9章。上证观察峰值5166，原始随后八十个观测搜索中的低点2927，约十一周跌43%。账户研究另行记录保证金约束与被迫卖出；总体指数自身不能识别跌幅中多少由追加保证金造成。

0bbf4e878776.en: The index, from public data. <bookmark mark='a'/> From about 2,050 in July twenty fourteen it rose 152 percent in eleven months. <bookmark mark='b'/> Then it fell by more than four tenths in under three months, with days of eight percent falls. <bookmark mark='c'/> And in the first week of twenty sixteen, two more: -6.9 and -7.0 percent, the days of the circuit breaker.
0bbf4e878776.zh: 指数，来自公开数据。<bookmark mark='a'/>从二〇一四年七月的约2050，它在十一个月里上涨了152%。<bookmark mark='b'/>然后在不到三个月里跌去四成以上，其中有单日百分之八的下跌。<bookmark mark='c'/>二〇一六年第一周又有两次：-6.9%和-7.0%，那是熔断的日子。

66fa73bd0f13.en: How the boom was financed. <bookmark mark='a'/> Brokers' margin loans passed two trillion yuan. <bookmark mark='b'/> And around them a grey market: umbrella trusts and lending platforms that gave retail investors five or ten times leverage, with automatic liquidation. Bian, He, Shue and Zhou later traced it account by account. <bookmark mark='c'/> In June the regulator moved to curb the grey channel. <bookmark mark='d'/> The rest was Chapter three, with a lock on the door: forced sales hit the ten percent daily limit, a seller who could not sell one stock sold another, and the selling spread.
66fa73bd0f13.zh: 这轮牛市的资金从哪里来。<bookmark mark='a'/>券商的融资余额超过了两万亿元。<bookmark mark='b'/>在它周围还有一个灰色市场：伞形信托和配资平台给散户五到十倍的杠杆，并自动平仓。卞、何、薛和周后来逐个账户地追踪了它。<bookmark mark='c'/>六月，监管机构着手清理场外配资。<bookmark mark='d'/>剩下的就是第3章，只不过门上加了锁：被迫卖出撞上百分之十的跌停板，卖不掉一只股票的人就去卖另一只，抛售随之扩散。

36d7b8f3f292.en: The response, as reported. <bookmark mark='a'/> A national team: state-backed buyers financed through the securities finance company, with central-bank money. <bookmark mark='b'/> Large shareholders were barred from selling, and new listings stopped. <bookmark mark='c'/> And in early July around half the listed companies suspended trading in their own shares. If you cannot sell what you hold, Chapter three says you sell what you can: the stocks that stayed open, and markets abroad.
36d7b8f3f292.zh: 据报道的应对。<bookmark mark='a'/>“国家队”：由国家支持的买家，通过证券金融公司获得中央银行资金。<bookmark mark='b'/>大股东被禁止减持，新股发行暂停。<bookmark mark='c'/>七月初，约一半上市公司停牌。如果你卖不掉你持有的东西，第3章说你就卖你能卖的：仍在交易的股票，以及海外市场。

47399576991d.en: The short-lived historical circuit breaker used the CSI three hundred, not the Shanghai Composite plotted above. <bookmark mark='a'/> From January fourth, twenty sixteen, a five-percent move in either direction ordinarily triggered a fifteen-minute market-wide halt; at or after two forty-five, it closed trading for the day. <bookmark mark='b'/> A seven-percent move in either direction also ended the day. <bookmark mark='c'/> On January fourth the downward triggers were reached; the separate Shanghai closing return here is -6.9 percent. <bookmark mark='d'/> On January seventh trading ended within roughly half an hour, with Shanghai at -7.0 percent. The mechanism was suspended that evening. Those Shanghai returns are observations, not the CSI trigger values.
47399576991d.zh: 短暂历史熔断使用CSI300，不是上图上证指数。<bookmark mark='a'/>二〇一六年一月四日起，任一方向变动百分之五通常停十五分钟；十四点四十五分及之后则当日收市。<bookmark mark='b'/>任一方向百分之七也结束当日交易。<bookmark mark='c'/>一月四日触及下跌阈值；这里单独记录的上证收盘收益为-6.9%。<bookmark mark='d'/>一月七日开盘约半小时就结束交易，上证-7.0%，机制当晚暂停。这些上证收益不是CSI触发值。

65dcb01445be.en: Why a trading barrier can attract trading. <bookmark mark='a'/> A trader anticipating future cash needs loses the option to sell while a halt is in force. <bookmark mark='b'/> In some models this encourages earlier selling near the threshold. <bookmark mark='c'/> That can accelerate a decline: a possible magnet mechanism, not a universal empirical law or a causal conclusion from two index returns. <bookmark mark='d'/> Design matters. Historical US market-wide rules use seven, thirteen and twenty percent declines, with lower-level pauses before three twenty-five and a twenty-percent closure. Comparing designs requires their time-of-day exceptions, reopening rules and market conditions.
65dcb01445be.zh: 交易障碍为何可能吸引交易。<bookmark mark='a'/>预计未来现金需求者在停牌时失去卖出选择。<bookmark mark='b'/>某些模型由此产生临近阈值提前卖出的激励。<bookmark mark='c'/>这可能加速下跌，即潜在磁吸机制，不是普遍经验规律，也不是两次指数收益得到的因果结论。<bookmark mark='d'/>设计很重要。历史美国全市场规则使用百分之七、十三、二十跌幅，较低档仅在十五点二十五分前暂停，二十档收市；须比较时段例外、重开规则与市场条件。

b745b75c5c14.en: Pause and predict. In a chosen balance-sheet example, a bank's bonds have book value one hundred but market value eighty-five, and deposit liabilities are ninety. What are book and marked equity, and what additional information is needed to assess its ability to meet withdrawals?
b745b75c5c14.zh: 暂停并预测。在选定资产负债表例子中，银行债券账面一百、市值八十五，存款负债九十。账面与市值权益分别多少？判断能否满足提款还需要什么信息？

8dc7a3a2f93f.en: Chapter ten. In the chosen example, book equity is one hundred minus ninety, or ten. Marked equity is eighty-five minus ninety, or minus five. Holding a bond to maturity can avoid a forced sale, but does not erase its current economic value loss, opportunity cost or funding obligations. Meeting withdrawals requires cash, collateral capacity, operational access and viable funding. This toy calculation illustrates a mechanism; it is not a complete valuation or solvency determination for Silicon Valley Bank.
8dc7a3a2f93f.zh: 第10章。选定例子的账面权益为一百减九十等于十；按市值是八十五减九十等于负五。持有到期可避免被迫卖出，但不会消除当前经济价值损失、机会成本或融资义务。满足提款需要现金、抵押能力、操作准入与可行融资。这是机制示例，不是硅谷银行完整估值或偿付判断。

e652c14188bf.en: London, September twenty twenty-two. <bookmark mark='a'/> Some liability-driven investment funds used gilt and derivatives exposures with leverage to hedge pension liabilities. <bookmark mark='b'/> Gilt yields rose sharply around the September mini-budget announcement. <bookmark mark='c'/> Collateral calls and gilt sales amplified market dysfunction. <bookmark mark='d'/> The Bank of England's temporary purchases ran from September twenty-eighth through October fourteenth: thirteen business days, not thirteen calendar days. The initial daily limits and eligible instruments were expanded during the intervention; this is a historical market-functioning episode.
e652c14188bf.zh: 伦敦，二〇二二年九月。<bookmark mark='a'/>部分LDI基金以国债、衍生品和杠杆对冲养老金负债。<bookmark mark='b'/>迷你预算公布前后国债收益率急升。<bookmark mark='c'/>抵押品追加和国债出售放大市场失灵。<bookmark mark='d'/>英格兰银行临时购买期从九月二十八日至十月十四日，共十三个工作日，不是十三个日历日；初始每日限额与合格工具在期间扩展。这是历史市场功能干预。

264a83ff2326.en: SVB Financial Group's reported end-two-thousand-twenty-two balance sheet provides context. <bookmark mark='a'/> Deposits are 173 billion dollars, mostly uninsured and concentrated among technology firms and investors. <bookmark mark='b'/> The unchanged illustration records 91.3 billion of held-to-maturity securities at cost and 76.2 at fair value. <bookmark mark='c'/> Their 15.1-billion pretax gap is close to 16.0 billion of group book equity. Simply subtracting it omits taxes, other valuations and bank-versus-group differences; it is not a regulatory or economic solvency proof. <bookmark mark='d'/> The Fed review reports over forty billion leaving March ninth, management expecting over one hundred billion more the next day, and closure on March tenth. The actual outflow and expected further outflow are different quantities.
264a83ff2326.zh: SVB金融集团报告的二〇二二年末表提供背景。<bookmark mark='a'/>存款173十亿美元，多数未保险，集中于科技企业与投资人。<bookmark mark='b'/>原例记录持有到期证券成本91.3、公允价值76.2十亿美元。<bookmark mark='c'/>税前差15.1，接近集团账面权益16.0十亿美元；直接相减忽略税、其他估值及银行集团差异，不是监管或经济偿付证明。<bookmark mark='d'/>联储报告三月九日流出超过四百亿美元，管理层预计次日还会流出超过一千亿，十日关闭。实际流出与预计后续流出不同。

85a483235e36.en: A chosen run-game illustration inspired by Diamond and Dybvig, rather than their complete liquidity-type contract model. Depositors form a continuum, are risk neutral, and each may request one now. Assets pay theta later or r under early liquidation. <bookmark mark='a'/> Early withdrawal pays one while f is at most r, then r divided by f; at f zero use payoff one by convention. <bookmark mark='b'/> Waiting pays theta times one minus f over r, divided by one minus f, for f below r, and zero once f reaches r. The green line includes that zero branch. <bookmark mark='c'/> With theta above one, no-run is an equilibrium. <bookmark mark='d'/> Everyone running is also an equilibrium: an individual who waits receives zero. This illustrates coordination failure under stated payoffs, not every feature of real deposits.
85a483235e36.zh: 受戴蒙德—迪布维格启发的选定博弈，并非完整流动性类型合约模型。存款人为连续统、风险中性，每人可立即提取一单位；资产未来支付theta、提前清算r。<bookmark mark='a'/>f不超过r时提前支付一，之后为r/f；f为零约定为一。<bookmark mark='b'/>f小于r时等待收益为theta乘一减f/r再除一减f；达到r后为零，绿线包含零分支。<bookmark mark='c'/>theta大于一时，不挤兑是均衡。<bookmark mark='d'/>全部挤兑也是均衡，因为个人等待得零。这在所述收益下说明协调失败，并非真实存款所有特征。

19f0ed45aecb.en: A selected global-games limiting calculation. The payoff structure, a locally flat prior and a vanishing private-noise argument give a uniform rank belief about other depositors' withdrawals. <bookmark mark='a'/> Conditional on those assumptions, the marginal depositor's expected wait-minus-run gap is zero at the threshold. This integral alone is not a general uniqueness proof for all banking games. <bookmark mark='b'/> We choose r equal to 0.85, giving 1.49. This is not a calibration of SVB's securities or funding structure. <bookmark mark='c'/> If half the depositors are assumed insured and never run, the threshold becomes 1.07. <bookmark mark='d'/> The unchanged finite quadrature and bisection give noisy-signal thresholds from 1.34 to 1.48 across the chosen decreasing noise levels. Their approach to the limiting number supports this numerical illustration, not a universal equilibrium theorem.
19f0ed45aecb.zh: 选定全局博弈极限计算。收益结构、局部平坦先验及私人噪声消失论证，给出对他人提款比例的均匀排序信念。<bookmark mark='a'/>这些假设下，边际存款人的平均等待减提款差在阈值为零；积分本身不是所有银行博弈的一般唯一性证明。<bookmark mark='b'/>选择r=0.85，得到1.49，不是SVB证券和融资结构标定。<bookmark mark='c'/>假设一半受保存款人永不挤兑，阈值为1.07。<bookmark mark='d'/>原有限求积与二分法在选定递减噪声下给出1.34至1.48，趋近极限支持此数值例子，不是普遍均衡定理。

b22f612b7892.en: Two descriptive FRED series. <bookmark mark='a'/> The two-year Treasury yield moves from 0.78 to a 5.19-percent maximum over the selected twenty-twenty-two and twenty-twenty-three window. This two-year extract does not establish a forty-year speed record, and individual bonds differ in duration and hedging. <bookmark mark='b'/> Seasonally adjusted aggregate commercial-bank deposits fall by 352 billion dollars between the selected weekly observations around March first and twenty-second. This is a net aggregate change. Transfers between banks alone do not lower aggregate bank deposits, and this series does not identify a decomposition into money-fund flows, within-bank shifts or other causes.
b22f612b7892.zh: 两个描述性FRED序列。<bookmark mark='a'/>选定二〇二二、二〇二三年窗口内，两年国债收益率从0.78%升至最高5.19%；两年数据不能证明四十年速度纪录，债券久期与对冲也不同。<bookmark mark='b'/>季调商业银行总存款在三月一日前后与二十二日前后的所选周观测间下降352十亿美元。这是总量净变化，银行间转账本身不会减少总存款；序列不能分解货币基金流动、银行内迁移及其他成因。

74d6b6d37622.en: Historical outcomes in March and May twenty twenty-three. <bookmark mark='a'/> Signature Bank was closed on March twelfth; First Republic was sold to JPMorgan in May after large deposit outflows. <bookmark mark='b'/> Swiss authorities arranged Credit Suisse's acquisition by UBS following sustained losses and severe liquidity pressure. <bookmark mark='c'/> FINMA's March twenty-third statement explained its AT1 write-down decision by reference to the instruments' viability-event clauses and the emergency ordinance. Shareholders receiving consideration did not make every jurisdiction's creditor hierarchy identical. This lesson does not assert a present-day litigation outcome or legal conclusion.
74d6b6d37622.zh: 二〇二三年三月和五月的历史结果。<bookmark mark='a'/>签名银行三月十二日关闭；第一共和银行大额存款流失后于五月售给摩根大通。<bookmark mark='b'/>瑞士当局在持续亏损与严重流动性压力后安排瑞银收购瑞信。<bookmark mark='c'/>FINMA三月二十三日声明依据存续事件条款与紧急条例解释AT1减记。股东获得对价不表示各司法辖区债权顺序相同；本课不声称当前诉讼结果或法律结论。

ed6bd2b89cb0.en: Policy changed funding incentives through concrete institutions. <bookmark mark='a'/> The historical systemic-risk exception protected all depositors of SVB and Signature in resolution, not every deposit at every bank in advance. <bookmark mark='b'/> The BTFP offered eligible institutions recourse advances against eligible securities valued at par, for up to one year, at a stated interest rate. Eligibility, March-twelfth ownership and repayment still mattered. A par collateral loan creates liquidity; it does not erase economic losses or literally set every bank's liquidation payoff to one. <bookmark mark='c'/> Nonbank funds and dealers also require attention. These episodes motivate measuring their financing links, rather than forecasting where the next run must begin.
ed6bd2b89cb0.zh: 具体制度改变融资激励。<bookmark mark='a'/>历史系统性风险例外在SVB与签名银行处置时保护全部存款人，不是事前给所有银行全部存款保险。<bookmark mark='b'/>BTFP对合格机构提供有追索权贷款，以合格证券面值计抵押品，最长一年、有规定利率，仍须满足资格、三月十二日持有及还款条件。按面值抵押贷款产生流动性，不抹掉经济损失，也不是把每家银行清算收益改成一。<bookmark mark='c'/>非银行基金和交易商亦需关注；事件说明应度量融资联系，而不是预言下一次挤兑必从哪里开始。

14e3d3c1ba5c.en: Pause and predict. A proposed teaching book holds the market at two times leverage with a twenty-five-percent haircut. Replay the worst market day within two thousand eight and double the haircut. What fraction must be sold? If positions equal half a day's normal volume, what volume-equivalent time follows from a ten-percent participation assumption, and why is that not an execution guarantee?
14e3d3c1ba5c.zh: 暂停并预测。拟议教学账簿以两倍杠杆持有市场，折扣率百分之二十五。重放二〇〇八年内最差市场日并将折扣率翻倍，应卖多少？若头寸为正常半天成交量，百分之十参与率给出多少成交量等价时间？为何不是执行保证？

67e2137e4ad7.en: The chosen public-market stress. <bookmark mark='a'/> The worst market return within two thousand eight occurs on December first, a 8.96 percent fall. This assumes the entire teaching book moves like that market, not a sealed strategy's realized path. <bookmark mark='b'/> At two times, equity one becomes 0.82. <bookmark mark='c'/> A fifty-percent haircut caps assets at twice that equity. <bookmark mark='d'/> The required sale is 10 percent of remaining assets. Positions equal to half a normal day's volume imply 0.5 volume-equivalent days at ten-percent participation. Actual depth, prices, volume and trading halts can prevent execution. This calculation is not a liquidity certificate.
67e2137e4ad7.zh: 选定公开市场压力。<bookmark mark='a'/>二〇〇八年内最差市场日十二月一日跌8.96%。假设整个教学账簿随市场变动，不是封存策略路径。<bookmark mark='b'/>两倍杠杆时权益一变为0.82。<bookmark mark='c'/>百分之五十折扣率把资产限于权益两倍。<bookmark mark='d'/>须卖剩余资产10%。头寸为正常半天量，百分之十参与率意味0.5成交量等价日。真实深度、价格、成交量与停牌可能阻止执行，算术不是流动性认证。

8973701319ef.en: Chapter eleven. A proposed treasury and funding rule for a teaching book. Its inputs here are ordinary public market returns and chosen financing assumptions. It does not read a sealed strategy outcome, certify live positions, or establish actual broker commitments. The exercise asks what a specified loss and haircut shock would require, and where the assumed ability to sell can fail.
8973701319ef.zh: 第11章。教学账簿的拟议资金与融资规则。这里输入普通公开市场收益及选定融资假设，不读取封存策略结果，不认证实盘持仓，也不建立真实经纪商承诺。题目问指定损失与折扣冲击会要求什么，以及假设的卖出能力会在哪些地方失效。

fd06375f5738.en: The same chosen stress across a fixed leverage grid. <bookmark mark='a'/> At a twenty-five-percent initial haircut, leverage above four is already infeasible for this single-book model; the extended curves illustrate hypothetical post-shock funding requirements. <bookmark mark='b'/> A fifty-percent or seventy-five-percent final haircut increases required sales. <bookmark mark='c'/> The dashed line is a chosen volume-equivalent day's sale, assuming ten-percent participation and half-a-day positions. It is not guaranteed stressed capacity. <bookmark mark='d'/> The largest tested quarter-step leverage satisfying the doubled-haircut arithmetic is 2.00. The dot uses that row's actual sale fraction. This discrete maximum is not an exactly solved continuous limit or an approved live leverage ceiling.
fd06375f5738.zh: 固定杠杆网格上的同一压力。<bookmark mark='a'/>初始折扣率百分之二十五时，超过四倍在单一账簿中已不可行，延长曲线只说明假设冲击后的融资需求。<bookmark mark='b'/>最终折扣率百分之五十或七十五增加卖出。<bookmark mark='c'/>虚线为假设正常半天头寸、十分之一参与率的一日成交量等价销售，不是压力容量保证。<bookmark mark='d'/>满足折扣翻倍算术的最大四分之一档测试杠杆为2.00，点采用该行实际卖出比例。这不是连续精确极限或已批准的实盘上限。

0fd36ac500cc.en: Against a real case. <bookmark mark='a'/> Archegos, a family office, held concentrated positions through total-return swaps at several prime brokers, each seeing only its own slice, as reported: LTCM's lesson, unlearned. <bookmark mark='b'/> Run the House's stress at five times, with positions of five days' volume: sell 76 percent of the book, which would take 38 days. <bookmark mark='c'/> In March twenty twenty-one, when one of its stocks fell, the banks did not wait. They sold blocks in a race to be first; Credit Suisse reported a loss of five and a half billion dollars; the founder was later convicted of fraud.
0fd36ac500cc.zh: 对照一个真实案例。<bookmark mark='a'/>据报道，家族办公室Archegos通过几家主经纪商的总收益互换持有高度集中的头寸，每家都只看得到自己的那一块：长期资本管理公司的教训，没有被吸取。<bookmark mark='b'/>以五倍杠杆、每个头寸五天成交量来运行本系列公司的压力测试：要卖掉账簿的76%，需要38天。<bookmark mark='c'/>二〇二一年三月，当它的一只股票下跌时，银行们没有等待。它们争先大宗抛售；瑞士信贷报告了五十五亿美元的损失；创始人后来被判欺诈罪成立。

42f0dd202a2a.en: A descriptive simulation on public market returns in two thousand eight and nine, with target leverage two. <bookmark mark='a'/> Volatility-linked haircuts produce 1.51 times starting equity in haircut-attributable sales. That statistic excludes ordinary target-leverage turnover. The book can re-lever toward its target after gains. <bookmark mark='b'/> The fixed haircut is 27 percent, chosen from half a multiplier based on a pre-two-thousand-eight ninety-ninth-percentile volatility estimate, with the coded floor and cap. This creates different headroom; it is not the same funding budget under a controlled intervention. <bookmark mark='c'/> End equity is 0.72 versus 0.53 for this window. That path-specific ordering does not prove forced selling is beneficial or that either policy protects a broker in general.
42f0dd202a2a.zh: 二〇〇八、〇九公开市场收益的描述性模拟，目标两倍。<bookmark mark='a'/>波动关联折扣率产生初始权益1.51倍的折扣率归因卖出，不包括普通目标再平衡；盈利后账簿也可重新加杠杆。<bookmark mark='b'/>固定折扣率为27%，按二〇〇八年前百分之九十九波动分位乘数的一半，再经原代码上下限得到。它改变融资余量，不是相同预算下的受控干预。<bookmark mark='c'/>期末权益0.72与0.53，此路径排序不证明强制卖出有益或任何政策普遍保护经纪商。

5cee835761cc.en: Private incentives and external effects. <bookmark mark='a'/> Our price-taking path comparison shows a particular equity ordering, not a general benefit from forced selling or proof that a broker avoided loss. <bookmark mark='b'/> Once many holders have price impact, their liquidations can depress collateral values and induce others' sales; this path simulator itself does not estimate that feedback. <bookmark mark='c'/> Models by Lorenzoni and Stein formalize settings where private decisions omit such effects. Anti-procyclicality tools are motivated by these concerns, but applicable requirements and their effects depend on institutions, contracts and historical rules.
5cee835761cc.zh: 私人激励与外部效应。<bookmark mark='a'/>价格接受者路径显示特定权益排序，不证明强制卖出普遍有益或经纪商避免损失。<bookmark mark='b'/>当许多持有人有价格冲击时，清算会压低抵押品价值并诱发他人卖出；本路径模拟本身不估计该反馈。<bookmark mark='c'/>洛伦佐尼和斯坦形式化了私人选择忽略外部效应的情形，逆周期工具以此为动机；实际规则与效果取决于制度、合同和历史。

85321b59a5fe.en: A proposed four-part research rule. <bookmark mark='a'/> Use 2.00 as the largest passing tested leverage under this specified two-thousand-eight shock, haircut and normal-volume arithmetic; examine further scenarios before any live limit. <bookmark mark='b'/> Seek legally and operationally reviewed term funding and counterparty diversification. No actual thirty-day margin lock is established here. <bookmark mark='c'/> Hold a separately defined liquidity buffer against additional collateral needs. <bookmark mark='d'/> Limit positions relative to stressed executable depth, rather than treating average volume as a promise. The proposal requires contract, execution and risk review before deployment.
85321b59a5fe.zh: 四部分拟议研究规则。<bookmark mark='a'/>在指定二〇〇八年冲击、折扣率及正常成交量算术下，最大通过测试杠杆为2.00，实盘上限之前还须更多场景。<bookmark mark='b'/>寻求法律与操作审阅的期限融资及对手方分散，未建立实际三十日保证金锁定。<bookmark mark='c'/>另设流动性缓冲以应对抵押需求。<bookmark mark='d'/>头寸应相对压力下可执行深度，而不能把平均成交量当承诺；部署前仍需合同、执行和风险审查。

14833d9d5827.en: The unchanged crisis library. The forced-sale function marks assets and equity, computes an equity-over-haircut cap and sells the positive excess. In the daily path, assets are reset to the smaller of target-leverage assets and the collateral cap; gains can lead to re-levering. The recorded forced amount is only the haircut-attributable reduction relative to the target, not all purchases and sales. We disclose those semantics rather than changing the financial algorithm.
14833d9d5827.zh: 原危机库。强制卖出函数先标记资产和权益，再算权益除折扣率上限，卖出正超额。日路径将资产重设为目标杠杆资产与抵押上限的较小者，盈利可导致重新加杠杆。记录的强制量只计相对目标的折扣率额外减仓，不是全部买卖。我们说明这些语义，不更改金融算法。

647c7214ed92.en: The chosen run-game code computes early and waiting payoffs, including the zero waiting branch after assets are exhausted. It averages wait-minus-run under a uniform rank belief, then numerically finds a threshold. The assumed flat local prior, payoff structure and insured non-running share are essential. These few lines illustrate a particular limiting construction; they do not prove general global-games uniqueness or model a recourse central-bank loan as a change in asset payoff.
647c7214ed92.zh: 选定挤兑代码计算提前与等待收益，包含资产耗尽后等待为零的分支。在均匀排序信念下平均等待减提款，再数值求阈值；局部平坦先验、收益结构及受保存款人不挤兑假设至关重要。这几行展示特定极限构造，不证明一般唯一性，也不把有追索权央行贷款当成资产收益变化。

8f8194676000.en: The crisis module supplies teaching tools. <bookmark mark='a'/> Leverage and margin, common-asset price impact, network clearing, systemic proxies and chosen run-game payoffs. These functions have different assumptions and are not one fitted crisis predictor. <bookmark mark='b'/> Proposed Rule forty-one combines stress arithmetic with funding, cash and executable-depth review. The ordinary public-return illustration neither accesses a sealed strategy nor establishes that any live book can liquidate within a day.
8f8194676000.zh: 危机模块提供教学工具。<bookmark mark='a'/>杠杆与保证金、共同资产冲击、网络清算、系统性代理及选定挤兑收益；各有不同假设，并非一个拟合危机预测器。<bookmark mark='b'/>拟议第41条将压力算术与融资、现金和可执行深度审查相结合。普通公开收益示例不访问封存策略，也不建立任何实盘账簿可一日清算的结论。

e5776fb813c5.en: Three tests to carry away. <bookmark mark='a'/> When a fund says it is market-neutral, ask what it must sell if its margins double tomorrow, and how many days that takes. <bookmark mark='b'/> When a bank holds bonds to maturity, ask what they are worth today, and how much of its funding can leave in a day. <bookmark mark='c'/> And when a network looks well diversified, ask against how large a shock: past the threshold, the links spread losses instead of sharing them.
e5776fb813c5.zh: 三个随身带走的检验。<bookmark mark='a'/>当一只基金说它是市场中性的，问它如果明天保证金加倍必须卖掉什么，需要几天。<bookmark mark='b'/>当一家银行把债券持有到期，问它们今天值多少，以及它有多少资金能在一天之内流走。<bookmark mark='c'/>当一个网络看起来分散得很好，问它是针对多大的冲击分散的：超过阈值，联系就是在传播损失，而不是分担损失。

899d656a6af6.en: For the researcher. We state a nonnegative-assets, limited-liability, pro-rata clearing model, prove existence and a sufficient regularity condition for uniqueness, and distinguish exact fictitious-default reasoning from the unchanged finite numerical solver. At most n strict additions to a default set may require n plus one outer checks including termination. We then derive the complete-network threshold with its debt and buffer conditions and compare the chosen numerical examples.
899d656a6af6.zh: 写给研究者。我们设定非负外部资产、有限责任、同顺位按比例清算模型，证明存在和唯一性的充分正则条件，并区分精确虚拟违约推理与原有限数值求解器。违约集合严格扩张最多n次，连终止检查可能需n加一次。随后在债务与缓冲条件下推导完全网络阈值，比较选定数值例子。

8a97eca59dbc.en: Eisenberg and Noe's model, two thousand and one. <bookmark mark='a'/> Bank i owes L i j to bank j, and p bar i in total. <bookmark mark='b'/> If it cannot pay in full, its creditors share pro rata: pi i j is j's share. <bookmark mark='c'/> A bank can pay its outside assets plus what it receives, but never more than it owes: the map phi. <bookmark mark='d'/> A clearing vector is a fixed point of phi. Each bank pays in full, or pays everything it has.
8a97eca59dbc.zh: 艾森伯格和诺伊的模型，二〇〇一年。<bookmark mark='a'/>银行i欠银行j L i j，总共欠p拔i。<bookmark mark='b'/>如果它付不了全额，债权人按比例分配：pi i j是j的份额。<bookmark mark='c'/>一家银行能付的是外部资产加上它收到的钱，但绝不超过它欠的：这就是映射phi。<bookmark mark='d'/>清算向量是phi的不动点。每家银行要么全额支付，要么付出它拥有的一切。

e360c10d8a3c.en: Theorem one, existence. <bookmark mark='a'/> Phi maps the box from zero to p bar into itself, and it is monotone: if others pay more, you can pay more. So by Tarski's fixed-point theorem, a greatest and a least clearing vector exist, and every other lies between them. <bookmark mark='b'/> And iteration finds them: from full payment downward, or from nothing upward.
e360c10d8a3c.zh: 定理一，存在性。<bookmark mark='a'/>phi把从零到p拔的盒子映射到它自身，而且是单调的：别人付得越多，你就能付得越多。所以由塔斯基不动点定理，最大和最小的清算向量存在，其他所有清算向量都在两者之间。<bookmark mark='b'/>迭代就能找到它们：从全额支付往下，或者从零往上。

8703da945449.en: The proof, for this map. <bookmark mark='a'/> Start from full payment. <bookmark mark='b'/> The first step can only lower payments, and applying a monotone map to an inequality keeps it, so the sequence falls. <bookmark mark='c'/> It is bounded below by zero, so it converges, and since phi is continuous the limit is a fixed point. <bookmark mark='d'/> Any other fixed point stays below every iterate, so this one is the greatest. From zero upward, the same argument gives the least.
8703da945449.zh: 针对这个映射的证明。<bookmark mark='a'/>从全额支付开始。<bookmark mark='b'/>第一步只会降低支付，而对一个不等式施加单调映射会保持它，所以这个序列下降。<bookmark mark='c'/>它以零为下界，所以收敛；由于phi连续，极限是一个不动点。<bookmark mark='d'/>任何其他不动点都在每一次迭代之下，所以这个是最大的。从零往上，同样的论证给出最小的。

b4a56fe28324.en: Theorem two, uniqueness. <bookmark mark='a'/> Suppose that from every bank, some chain of obligations reaches a bank with positive outside assets. <bookmark mark='b'/> Then the greatest and least clearing vectors coincide: there is one answer. The condition fails only for a group that owes only to itself and holds nothing else.
b4a56fe28324.zh: 定理二，唯一性。<bookmark mark='a'/>假设从每家银行出发，都有一条债务链通向一家外部资产为正的银行。<bookmark mark='b'/>那么最大和最小的清算向量重合：答案只有一个。只有当一组银行只欠自己人、又别无他物时，这个条件才会失效。

a36afe11ddf0.en: The proof. <bookmark mark='a'/> Let d be the difference between the greatest and least vectors, and S the banks where it is positive. <bookmark mark='b'/> A bank in S pays less than it owes under the least vector, so there it pays everything it has; under the greatest it pays at most that. <bookmark mark='c'/> Subtract and sum over S. Banks outside S contribute nothing, and each row of pi sums to at most one. <bookmark mark='d'/> So the chain of inequalities is tight: every bank in S pays only to banks in S.
a36afe11ddf0.zh: 证明。<bookmark mark='a'/>令d为最大向量与最小向量之差，S为d为正的银行集合。<bookmark mark='b'/>S中的银行在最小向量下付的少于它欠的，所以在那里它付出全部所有；在最大向量下它至多付出那么多。<bookmark mark='c'/>相减并对S求和。S之外的银行不贡献任何东西，而pi的每一行之和至多为一。<bookmark mark='d'/>所以这串不等式是紧的：S中的每家银行只向S中的银行付款。

dab43690c92b.en: And the end. <bookmark mark='a'/> Under the greatest vector, the banks in S also pay all they have. <bookmark mark='b'/> Split what they receive into payments from inside S, which add up to S's own payments, and payments from outside. <bookmark mark='c'/> Cancel, and what remains is non-negative and sums to zero: no outside assets in S, and nothing flowing in. <bookmark mark='d'/> That is a closed group with nothing outside, which regularity forbids. So S is empty, and the clearing vector is unique.
dab43690c92b.zh: 最后一步。<bookmark mark='a'/>在最大向量下，S中的银行也付出它们拥有的全部。<bookmark mark='b'/>把它们收到的钱分成来自S内部的支付，其总和等于S自己的支付，以及来自外部的支付。<bookmark mark='c'/>相消之后，剩下的是非负的，且总和为零：S里没有外部资产，也没有钱流入。<bookmark mark='d'/>这是一个外面什么也没有的封闭群体，而正则性禁止这种情况。所以S是空集，清算向量是唯一的。
