93b02b06e29a.en: Fictitious default in the regular, nonnegative-assets model. <bookmark mark='a'/> Start with all banks paying in full and no defaults. <bookmark mark='b'/> Find newly insolvent banks from outside assets plus incoming payments. <bookmark mark='c'/> With nondefaulters paying in full, solve the defaulting subsystem; under the stated conditions this gives the appropriate reduced payment vector. The unchanged code approximates that step by finite Picard iteration with a tolerance. <bookmark mark='d'/> Payments decrease and the default set grows. At most n strict enlargements are possible, with an additional termination check. Numerical outer-round counts include checks, so the bound is not automatically n total loop evaluations.
93b02b06e29a.zh: 正则、非负外部资产模型中的虚拟违约。<bookmark mark='a'/>从无人违约、全部支付开始。<bookmark mark='b'/>由外部资产加流入找出新无力支付者。<bookmark mark='c'/>非违约者全额支付时解违约子系统；所述条件下给出适当降低的支付向量。原代码用有限Picard次数与容差近似这一步。<bookmark mark='d'/>支付下降、违约集合扩大，严格扩张最多n次，另有终止检查。数值外层轮数包含检查，所以不能自动称总循环最多n次。

607d074dd29f.en: The unchanged numerical check. <bookmark mark='a'/> 200 chosen random twelve-bank networks have strictly positive outside assets almost surely, satisfying the sufficient regularity condition; zero-debt rows use zero payment shares. <bookmark mark='b'/> In 200 of 200, fictitious default and monotone iteration from the top and bottom agree within ten to the minus eight. This supports the implementation on these cases and is not the proof of uniqueness. <bookmark mark='c'/> The maximum outer-check count is 5, averaging 3.19. Those counts include the final no-change check and finite numerical stopping; the theorem bounds strict default-set enlargements.
607d074dd29f.zh: 原数值检验。<bookmark mark='a'/>选定200个十二银行随机网络，外部资产几乎必然严格为正，满足充分正则性；零债务行的支付份额定义为零。<bookmark mark='b'/>在200例中，200例虚拟违约与从上下迭代在十的负八次方内一致。这支持这些实现案例，并非唯一性证明本身。<bookmark mark='c'/>外层检查最多5次、平均3.19，含最终无变化检查及有限数值停止；定理界限针对严格集合扩张。

109300ebcc6c.en: And the counterexample when regularity fails. <bookmark mark='a'/> Two banks owe each other one, and hold nothing else. <bookmark mark='b'/> Paying in full is a clearing vector: each receives one and pays it on. So is paying nothing. Iteration from above finds the first, from below the second. The theorem's condition is not a technicality.
109300ebcc6c.zh: 以及正则性失效时的反例。<bookmark mark='a'/>两家银行互相欠一，别无他物。<bookmark mark='b'/>全额支付是一个清算向量：每家收到一，再把它付出去。什么都不付也是。从上往下迭代找到前者，从下往上找到后者。定理的条件不是一个技术细节。

d7a8292d697f.en: The symmetric complete-network result needs conditions. <bookmark mark='a'/> Let b equal a minus v, positive; each bank owes y to the others equally. Assume y exceeds n minus one times b and use the stated greatest-clearing senior-resource model. Then all banks default exactly when epsilon exceeds n b. <bookmark mark='b'/> Epsilon at most b causes zero defaults. Between b and n b, only the shocked bank defaults. Above n b, all default. At the threshold equality the other banks can still pay in full. These qualifications exclude low-interbank-debt counterexamples.
d7a8292d697f.zh: 对称完全网络结论需要条件。<bookmark mark='a'/>令正缓冲b=a减v，每家对其余均匀负债y，并假设y大于n减一乘b，采用所述最大清算优先资源模型。此时全违约当且仅当epsilon大于nb。<bookmark mark='b'/>epsilon不超过b时无违约；b与nb之间仅受冲击者违约；超过nb全违约；等号时其他人仍能付清。这排除了银行间债务太小的反例。

2f33bf60ed95.en: The derivation with clipping made explicit. <bookmark mark='a'/> When all others pay, the hit bank's interbank payment is its net resources clipped between zero and y. Negative net resources mean a shortfall against senior obligations, not literally negative gross assets. <bookmark mark='b'/> Its shortfall is min of y and the positive part of epsilon minus b. <bookmark mark='c'/> Each other bank loses one over n minus one of that amount. <bookmark mark='d'/> Since y exceeds n minus one times b, the other banks' buffers are breached exactly when epsilon exceeds n b. Symmetry and greatest-payment iteration then imply all-default. If y were too small, saturation at zero would prevent this argument.
2f33bf60ed95.zh: 把截断写清的推导。<bookmark mark='a'/>其他人全付时，受冲击者的银行间支付为净资源截在零和y之间。净资源为负表示对优先义务的缺口，不是负的总资产。<bookmark mark='b'/>短缺为y与epsilon减b正部的较小者。<bookmark mark='c'/>每家其他银行损失其n减一分之一。<bookmark mark='d'/>由于y大于n减一乘b，缓冲恰在epsilon超过nb时被击穿；对称性与最大支付迭代意味着全部违约。若y太小，支付降到零的饱和会阻断此推理。

259c5226d8dc.en: The check, on a grid of shocks a twentieth apart. <bookmark mark='a'/> The ring loses one bank at a time as the shock grows. <bookmark mark='b'/> The complete network loses one bank, then all ten, at 5.05: the first grid point above the formula's 5. <bookmark mark='c'/> And two clusters, weakly linked, stop at five: the loss spreads within a cluster, and the thin link between them is a firewall.
259c5226d8dc.zh: 检验，在间隔二十分之一的冲击网格上。<bookmark mark='a'/>随着冲击增大，环形网络一次失去一家银行。<bookmark mark='b'/>完全网络先失去一家，然后在5.05处失去全部十家：这是公式给出的5之上的第一个网格点。<bookmark mark='c'/>两个弱连接的簇停在五家：损失在簇内扩散，而簇之间细弱的联系是一道防火墙。

806b9b7c49f4.en: Add a chosen common-asset cascade. <bookmark mark='a'/> Each bank owns one asset unit; defaults cause liquidation, and price is exp of minus zero point one five times units sold. The code allows fifty iterations and a finite stopping rule. This is related to the fire-sale literature, not a reproduction or calibration of Cifuentes, Ferrucci and Shin. <bookmark mark='b'/> At the chosen shock four, the complete network has 1 default without price effects and 10 with them. These selected cases demonstrate how common-asset marks can reduce buffers. They do not prove global convergence, uniqueness or a universal size of amplification.
806b9b7c49f4.zh: 加入选定共同资产级联。<bookmark mark='a'/>每家持有一单位，违约就清算，价格为exp负零点一五乘卖出单位数。代码最多五十轮并有有限停止规则；与甩卖文献相关，但不是Cifuentes等人的复现或标定。<bookmark mark='b'/>冲击四时，完全网络不含价格效应有1家违约，加入后10家。选例说明共同估值可降低缓冲，不证明全局收敛、唯一或普遍放大倍数。

9227aa35ebe2.en: Extensions and their conditions. <bookmark mark='a'/> Rogers and Veraart add default costs, which can change equilibrium multiplicity and incentives for rescues. That is a model mechanism, not proof of individual LTCM creditors' motives. <bookmark mark='b'/> Glasserman and Young derive bounds on network amplification under stated assumptions. Payment redistribution, outside losses and the number of defaults are different quantities; no universal small-contagion theorem follows for our closed-network default counts. <bookmark mark='c'/> Elliott, Golub and Jackson study how integration and diversification affect cascades within specified network models. Their comparisons are not an unrestricted ranking of every topology.
9227aa35ebe2.zh: 扩展及条件。<bookmark mark='a'/>罗杰斯与韦拉尔加入违约成本，可能改变均衡多重性与救助激励；这是机制，不是对LTCM每个债权人动机的证明。<bookmark mark='b'/>格拉瑟曼与杨在特定条件下界定网络放大。支付再分配、外部损失和违约家数不同，不能据此给本封闭网络违约数套一个普遍小传染定理。<bookmark mark='c'/>埃利奥特、戈卢布与杰克逊在指定网络模型中研究整合与分散对级联的影响，不是所有拓扑的无限制排名。

b49b94ede411.en: Three open problems. <bookmark mark='a'/> Incomplete bilateral exposures: maximum-entropy reconstruction spreads links but can understate or overstate the selected contagion metric. Reconstruction assumptions must be evaluated, not treated as a universal directional theorem. <bookmark mark='b'/> Networks with prices, defaults and runs together: existence, multiplicity and computation depend on liquidation and contract rules. <bookmark mark='c'/> Links among funds, dealers, clearing houses and other nonbanks remain unevenly observed. Coverage and stressed valuation matter alongside the network equations.
b49b94ede411.zh: 三个开放问题。<bookmark mark='a'/>双边数据不完整；最大熵把连接分散，但对选定传染指标可低估或高估，须评价重建假设，不能当普遍方向定理。<bookmark mark='b'/>同时含价格、违约与挤兑的网络，其存在、多解及计算取决于清算与合同规则。<bookmark mark='c'/>基金、交易商、清算机构和其他非银行联系的观测不均；覆盖与压力估值同网络方程一样重要。

d3899c3febfa.en: Pause and predict. Three banks in a ring each owe the next one, and hold outside assets of a half. Is the clearing vector unique, and what is it?
d3899c3febfa.zh: 暂停并预测。三家银行排成环形，每家欠下一家一，各自持有一半的外部资产。清算向量唯一吗，它是什么？

3b80219c544d.en: Part forty-one in thirteen lines. Leverage magnifies losses under stated balance-sheet assumptions. The chosen five-times fund sells most of its remaining book after its loss and haircut shock. Chosen loss and margin spirals amplify a small initial shock. Common holdings transmit price impact. Network effects depend on buffers, debt and topology. CoVaR is a fitted association; the Lehman shortfall is an explicitly approximate proxy. LTCM illustrates crowded financing exposure; the four-percent calculation is only a uniform-loss balance-sheet bridge.
3b80219c544d.zh: 第41部分十三行。在所述资产负债表假设下杠杆放大损失；选定五倍基金受损及折扣冲击后卖出大部分剩余账簿；选定螺旋放大小冲击。共同持仓传递价格冲击，网络作用取决于缓冲、债务与拓扑。CoVaR是拟合关联，雷曼短缺为明确近似代理。LTCM说明拥挤融资敞口，百分之四只是一致资产跌幅桥梁。

956991be0ac2.en: The two-thousand-eight wholesale-funding crisis and acute March twenty-twenty market dysfunction involved different institutions and losses. China's index observations do not by themselves identify margin-call or circuit-breaker effects. The chosen run game states its payoff and signal assumptions; historical bank funding facilities are separate contracts. Proposed Rule forty-one combines stress arithmetic with financing and executable-depth review. The research chapter proves clearing existence and sufficient conditions for uniqueness, distinguishes numerical checks from strict default-set additions, and qualifies the complete-network threshold.
956991be0ac2.zh: 二〇〇八年批发融资危机与二〇二〇年三月急性市场失灵涉及不同机构和损失。中国指数自身不能识别追加保证金或熔断效应。选定挤兑博弈须说明收益与信号，历史银行融资工具则是独立合同。拟议第41条结合压力算术、融资与可执行深度。研究章证明清算存在及唯一的充分条件，区分数值检查与严格违约集合扩张，并给完全网络阈值加上条件。

708c8fb69ef8.en: Three lessons. <bookmark mark='a'/> Accounting equity alone does not establish economic solvency or the cash and collateral needed to meet withdrawals. Funding and valuation must both be examined. <bookmark mark='b'/> Crowded positions and lenders can create common liquidation pressure; one holder's available exit need not remain available when many sell. <bookmark mark='c'/> Backstops can support funding and market functioning while changing incentives and imposing costs. These descriptive episodes do not prove that every intervention alone ended a panic or identify its full causal effect.
708c8fb69ef8.zh: 三个教训。<bookmark mark='a'/>账面权益本身不能证明经济偿付或满足提款的现金抵押品能力，须同时研究融资与估值。<bookmark mark='b'/>拥挤头寸与贷款方造成共同清算压力，一家可用的出口未必在多家一起卖时仍可用。<bookmark mark='c'/>后盾可支持融资和市场功能，也改变激励并有成本。描述性事件不能证明每次干预单独终结恐慌或识别完整因果效应。

b55a14e1f6c2.en: The part on one card, under its stated domains. Forced sale uses positive parts for the collateral cap and excess; the geometric multiplier requires feedback below one. The clearing equation assumes nonnegative resources and pro-rata equal-priority payments. The complete-network threshold needs a positive buffer and sufficient interbank debt. Delta CoVaR is a fitted association, and SRISK retains the one-minus-k factor. Waiting is zero after f reaches r; the final integral selects the uniform-rank no-insurance threshold under the chosen payoff and belief assumptions.
b55a14e1f6c2.zh: 一张公式卡，在所述定义域内。卖出式对抵押上限与超额取正部；几何乘数要求反馈小于一。清算方程假设非负资源及同顺位按比例支付，完全网络阈值需要正缓冲与足够银行间债务。ΔCoVaR是拟合关联，SRISK保留一减k。f达到r后等待为零；最后积分在选定收益与信念假设下选择无保险的均匀排序阈值。

e6b13c7b8c10.en: How this part connects. <bookmark mark='a'/> Backwards: margin, LTCM, credit, clearing, impact, stablecoin runs and risk numbers all meet in a crisis. <bookmark mark='b'/> Sideways: a fire sale is market impact paid by everyone at once, and a bank run is a depeg with deposits. <bookmark mark='c'/> Forwards: Part forty-two asks what happens when the crowd is machines sharing one model, and Part forty-three whether anyone is paid for bearing this risk.
e6b13c7b8c10.zh: 这一部分如何与其他部分相连。<bookmark mark='a'/>向后：保证金、长期资本管理公司、信用、清算、冲击成本、稳定币挤兑和风险数字，都在一场危机中相遇。<bookmark mark='b'/>横向：甩卖是所有人同时支付的市场冲击成本，银行挤兑是以存款代替代币的脱锚。<bookmark mark='c'/>向前：第42部分追问当人群是共享同一个模型的机器时会发生什么，第43部分追问是否有人因承担这种风险而获得回报。

5495f0e91f15.en: Six desk questions. The hook's: at five times, down ten percent, with a thirty percent haircut, sell fifty-six point seven of ninety. <bookmark mark='a'/> How can a solvent bank fail? A run, when assets sold early fetch less than they are worth. <bookmark mark='b'/> Loss spirals keep leverage constant; margin spirals lower the leverage allowed.
5495f0e91f15.zh: 六个交易台问题。开场的那个：五倍杠杆、下跌百分之十、折扣率百分之三十，九十中要卖掉五十六点七。<bookmark mark='a'/>有偿付能力的银行怎么会倒闭？挤兑，当提前卖出的资产拿不回它们的价值时。<bookmark mark='b'/>损失螺旋维持杠杆不变；保证金螺旋降低允许的杠杆。

b89db055887b.en: Is a connected system safer? In the specified symmetric model, buffers and interbank debt determine its zero, one and all-default regimes; no universal topology ranking follows. <bookmark mark='a'/> Measures of systemic risk? Delta CoVaR describes conditional association, MES exposure, and SRISK a modeled shortfall; our Lehman proxy is not standard firm-specific SRISK. <bookmark mark='b'/> And March twenty twenty? Official reviews describe several cash-seeking sellers and constraints on intermediation. These index and yield charts do not identify a single cause or prove the effect of policy alone. Full solutions and limitations are in the notes.
b89db055887b.zh: 连接紧密更安全吗？指定对称模型中，缓冲与银行间债务决定零、一、全违约区间，不能推出普遍拓扑排名。<bookmark mark='a'/>系统性度量呢？ΔCoVaR描述条件关联、MES描述敞口、SRISK描述建模短缺；雷曼代理不是标准公司级SRISK。<bookmark mark='b'/>二〇二〇年三月呢？官方复盘描述多种寻求现金的卖方和中介约束，指数收益率不能识别单一原因或单独证明政策效果。完整解答与限制见笔记。

b4c559f4d38e.en: The research chapter's pause, answered. <bookmark mark='a'/> Every bank holds a half outside, so the system is regular and the clearing vector unique. <bookmark mark='b'/> And it is full payment: each bank receives one, holds a half, pays its one and keeps a half. Plugging in confirms the fixed point.
b4c559f4d38e.zh: 研究者章节的暂停问题，答案来了。<bookmark mark='a'/>每家银行都持有一半的外部资产，所以体系是正则的，清算向量唯一。<bookmark mark='b'/>它就是全额支付：每家银行收到一，持有一半，付出它的一，留下一半。代入验证，确实是不动点。

c2d777735b03.en: Twelve problems with complete English and Chinese solutions in the notes. <bookmark mark='a'/> Foundations, one through six. Mark equity and leverage after a five-percent loss, then calculate the debt-repaying sale that restores four times. Calculate a forced sale when an eight-times book loses three percent and its haircut doubles. For a local linear-impact spiral derive the geometric multiplier and state its stability condition. Distinguish exact leverage-minus-one restoration from the unchanged high-leverage fire-sale approximation. Solve the fully specified three-bank clearing system and verify each payment and equity. Then apply the complete-network threshold with positive buffers and sufficient interbank debt. <bookmark mark='b'/> Advanced practice, seven through ten. Compute a fitted delta CoVaR without interpreting it as causal. Compute SRISK with the one-minus-k factor. Compare early and waiting payoffs at a chosen withdrawal share. And mark a chosen bond-and-cash balance sheet after a duration-approximated yield shock, identifying omitted convexity and funding effects. <bookmark mark='c'/> Qualifying problems, eleven and twelve. Prove clearing existence and regularity-based uniqueness, with the zero-debt convention and precise default-set bound. Derive the chosen uniform-rank run threshold, show why it exceeds one, and analyze the insured non-running share under the stated payoff and belief assumptions.
c2d777735b03.zh: 十二道题，笔记给出完整英中文解答。<bookmark mark='a'/>基础一至六。资产损失百分之五后计算权益、杠杆和还债式卖出来恢复四倍。八倍账簿跌百分之三且折扣率翻倍，算强制卖出。推导局部线性冲击几何乘数并说明稳定条件。区分精确杠杆减一恢复与原高杠杆近似。解完整三银行清算并验证支付和权益。用正缓冲及足够银行间债务推完全网络阈值。<bookmark mark='b'/>进阶七至十。算拟合ΔCoVaR但不作因果解释。保留一减k算SRISK。在选定提款比例比较提前与等待。对选定债券现金表用久期近似利率冲击，说明遗漏凸性和融资效应。<bookmark mark='c'/>资格十一、十二。证明清算存在与正则性下唯一，给零债务约定和精确集合扩张界限。推选定均匀排序挤兑阈值，证明大于一，并在所述收益和信念下分析受保不挤兑份额。

d7355c1a02bb.en: Where this comes back. Part forty-two puts machines in the market, and asks whether a crowd sharing one model herds into the same spirals. And Part forty-three asks whether anyone is paid for bearing crash and liquidity risk.
d7355c1a02bb.zh: 这些内容会在哪里再次出现。第42部分把机器放进市场，追问共享同一个模型的人群是否会一起冲进同样的螺旋。第43部分追问是否有人因承担崩盘和流动性风险而获得回报。

090e09cc24ba.en: The textbooks this part follows, and the papers it draws on, from Diamond and Dybvig to SRISK. Every number on screen was computed by the House's code from FRED, Kenneth French's daily returns through twenty twenty, public index data and public filings, or from simulation.
090e09cc24ba.zh: 这一部分依循的教科书，以及它引用的论文，从戴蒙德和迪布维格到SRISK。屏幕上的每个数字都由本系列公司的代码计算得出，数据来自FRED、肯尼斯·弗伦奇截至二〇二〇年的日收益、公开的指数数据和公开文件，或者来自模拟。

761534d61a5c.en: The House now has a proposed stress framework and a clearer account of its assumptions. It still needs financing, executable-depth and risk review before any live leverage limit. <bookmark mark='a'/> Next, Part forty-two: machines in the market. We will examine simulated markets, learning traders, pricing algorithms and common-model exposure, distinguishing outcomes in chosen games from claims about real-world intent or market performance.
761534d61a5c.zh: 本系列公司得到拟议压力框架及更清楚的假设，但实盘杠杆上限仍须融资、可执行深度及风险审查。<bookmark mark='a'/>下一部分42：市场中的机器。研究模拟市场、学习交易者、定价算法和共同模型敞口，区分选定博弈结果与真实意图或市场表现的声称。
